english: A Keis belongs to the Karoo, the semidesert country of southern Africa. Low rainfall, dry air and marked temperature extremes characterize the wider region, whose exposed sedimentary rocks preserve a rich fossil record.
simp_chinese: 阿凯斯属于非洲南部的卡鲁半荒漠地区。更广阔的地区降雨稀少、空气干燥、温差显著，裸露的沉积岩层保存着丰富的化石记录。

english: A’taw’bun’kut’en belongs to the Dakelh country of interior British Columbia. The Dakelh also call themselves Yinka Dene, meaning the people on the land, and their territories embrace the Fraser River interior and numerous lake districts.
simp_chinese: 阿托邦库滕属于不列颠哥伦比亚内陆的达凯尔地区。达凯尔人亦自称Yinka Dene，意为土地上的人，其乡土包括弗雷泽河内陆和众多湖区。

english: Aa'kw Kwáan means Small Lake People, the name of an Auke subgroup of the Tlingit. Their homeland lies around the Juneau area and adjoining islands. Seasonal festivals celebrated the spawning-time herring harvest, tying community life to the rhythms of coastal waters.
simp_chinese: 阿库宽意为小湖人，是特林吉特人中奥克群体的自称。其家园位于朱诺周边及邻近岛屿。季节性节庆庆祝鲱鱼产卵期的收获，将社群生活与沿海水域的节律相连。

english:
Aabenraa, known in German as Apenrade and in South Jutlandic as Affenråe, stands at the head of Aabenraa Fjord, an inlet of the Little Belt in southern Denmark. It lies about twenty-six kilometres north of the modern border with Germany and roughly thirty-two kilometres north of Flensburg. The name is traditionally explained as “open beach,” from the Danish åben strand, an image that fits a settlement whose identity has long been bound to its sheltered anchorage and the waters beyond it.

The town enters written history in the twelfth century, when it was attacked by Wends. It developed in the early Middle Ages around Opnør Hus, a bishop’s castle, and acquired the status of a merchant town in 1240. A charter followed in 1335. Fishing and the cultivation and processing of hops gave the medieval community its livelihood, while its position at the head of a navigable fjord allowed ships to connect the town with the wider Baltic and North Sea worlds. From 1560 until 1721 Aabenraa was ruled by the dukes of Holstein-Gottorp, a reminder that this part of Jutland sat at a cultural and political crossroads rather than within a fixed national border.

The town’s commercial golden age came between the 1750s and about 1864. Its harbor offered shelter for a large carrying trade, and Aabenraa’s merchant fleet ranked third in the Danish monarchy after those of Copenhagen and Flensburg. Shipyards turned out vessels noted for their quality. The best known was the clipper Cimber, which sailed from Liverpool to San Francisco in 1857 in 106 days. Fishing, shipbuilding, and a variety of small manufactures supported a population whose prosperity depended on distant routes as much as local resources.

The Second Schleswig War brought Aabenraa into Prussia in 1864, then into the North German Confederation and, after 1871, the German Empire. The Schleswig plebiscites of 1920 produced a divided result in the district: 55.1 percent of Aabenraa’s inhabitants voted to remain with Germany and 44.9 percent for Denmark, but the surrounding municipality favored Denmark, and the town was transferred to the Danish crown. A later episode reveals how strongly residents guarded the town’s identity: after the 1948 spelling reform replaced Aa with Å, they resisted changing the name because Å would have moved Aabenraa to the end of alphabetical lists. The Aa spelling remains widely used today.

Modern Aabenraa is an administrative and shipping center with a deep harbor, organ building, machine works, a German minority and its German-language newspaper. St. Nicholas Church, begun around 1250 under King Valdemar, preserves the medieval phase of a town whose story repeatedly joined local craft, maritime commerce, dynastic rule and the contested borderlands between Denmark and Germany.
simp_chinese:
奥本罗在德语中称阿彭拉德，在 Sønderjylland 方言中称 Affenråe，位于丹麦南部小贝尔特海峡的一处水湾——奥本罗峡湾的顶端。这里距今日丹麦与德国的边界约二十六公里，距弗伦斯堡约三十二公里。地名传统上被解释为“开阔的海滩”，来自丹麦语 åben strand；这个说法也映照出当地长期依凭避风港湾和海上交通发展的身份。

奥本罗在十二世纪见于文字记载，当时遭到文德人袭击。中世纪早期，聚落围绕主教城堡 Opnør Hus 成长，1240年取得集镇地位，1335年又获得特许状。捕鱼以及啤酒花的种植和加工支撑了中世纪居民的生计；地处可航峡湾的顶端，也使船只能够把这里同波罗的海和北海沿岸更广阔的商业世界联系起来。1560年至1721年，奥本罗受荷尔斯泰因-戈托普公爵统治，这段经历说明日德兰南部长期处在王朝政治与文化边界交汇的位置，并非始终属于一个固定不变的国家。

约从1750年代到1864年，奥本罗迎来商业鼎盛期。港湾为大规模的转口运输提供了庇护，其商船队规模在丹麦君主国中位居第三，仅次于哥本哈根和弗伦斯堡。当地船厂以建造质量优良的船舶闻名，其中最著名的剪式帆船“Cimber”号曾在1857年用106天从利物浦航行到旧金山。捕鱼、造船以及多种小型制造业共同维持城镇繁荣；奥本罗的财富既依赖本地物产，也依赖通往遥远港口的航线。

第二次石勒苏益格战争后，奥本罗于1864年归属普鲁士，继而成为北德意志邦联的一部分；1871年以后又属于德意志帝国。1920年的石勒苏益格公投在城镇与周边乡村留下了相反的结果：奥本罗55.1%的居民赞成留在德国，44.9%赞成归属丹麦；但周边市镇多数支持加入丹麦，奥本罗最终转归丹麦。1948年丹麦正字法改革以字母 Å 取代双写 Aa，当地居民又为保留旧拼写展开激烈抵制，因为 Å 会使这座据说举世最早按字母排列的城镇移动到列表末尾。后来规则允许继续使用 Aa，今天当地大多数人仍采用这一写法。

今日的奥本罗是行政与航运中心，拥有较深的港湾、管风琴制造厂和机械厂，也居住着使用德语并出版德语报纸的少数族群。始建于约1250年、相传可追溯至瓦尔德马国王时代的圣尼古拉教堂，保存着城镇中世纪阶段的痕迹。奥本罗的历史不断把地方手工业、海洋贸易、王朝统治以及丹德边境地区的争夺编织在一起，使它成为日德兰南部一座具有鲜明边界经验的城市。

english: Aaboukingon lies in the Kentucky country associated with the Shawnee. These Algonquian-speaking people spread widely through the Ohio Valley and neighboring regions after seventeenth-century dispersals. Their later struggle to retain their homelands culminated in wars and treaties that preceded removal westward.
simp_chinese: 阿布金贡位于与肖尼人相关的肯塔基地区。这个说阿尔冈昆语族语言的民族在十七世纪离散之后，广泛分布于俄亥俄河谷及邻近地区。此后他们为保住故土而斗争，历经战争与割地条约，最终被迫西迁。

english: Aachen became linked with Cologne by the Rhenish Railway Company’s line opened in 1841. Its extension into Belgium in 1843 made this corridor one of the earliest international railway connections.
simp_chinese: 亚琛在1841年开通的莱茵铁路公司线路中与科隆相连。线路于1843年延伸进入比利时，使这条走廊成为最早的国际铁路联系之一。

english: Aahkawiraahkata belongs to the Central Great Plains. Across this wider region, mixed-grass prairies form a transition between the taller grasslands to the east and the shortgrass country to the west.
simp_chinese: 阿卡维拉卡塔属于中央大平原。纵观广义地区，混合草原构成东侧高草草原与西侧短草地区之间的过渡。

english: Aahkawirahkata belongs to the Wyoming region of the North American interior. Across the wider region, Rocky Mountain ranges in the west give way to high prairie in the east, and the Crow, Arapaho, Lakota and Shoshone were among its Indigenous inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 阿卡维拉卡塔属于北美内陆的怀俄明地区。更广阔的地区由西部落基山脉向东部高地草原过渡，克劳人、阿拉帕霍人、拉科塔人与肖肖尼人都是当地原住民的一部分。

english: Aakhoe belongs to the Namib country of southwestern Africa. The wider coastal desert runs along the Atlantic and rises inland towards the Great Escarpment, linking coastal aridity with the plateau margin.
simp_chinese: 阿科属于非洲西南纳米布地区。广阔沿海沙漠沿大西洋展开，向内陆逐渐上升至大断崖，把干旱海岸与高原边缘连接起来。

english: Áak’u, or Acoma, is a Keres Pueblo community west of present-day Albuquerque. Its people have occupied this country for more than two thousand years, and the settlement is among the oldest continuously inhabited communities in the United States.
simp_chinese: 阿库，即阿科马，是今日阿尔伯克基以西的克雷斯普韦布洛社群。其居民已在这片地区生活两千多年，这里是美国持续有人居住的最古老社群之一。

english: Aalborg belongs to Northern Jutland, the historical Danish country north of the Kongeå. The wider region had its own medieval ting assembly, which met at Viborg.
simp_chinese: 奥尔堡属于康厄河以北丹麦历史上的北日德兰地区。更广阔的地区在中世纪拥有自己的庭议会，集会地点位于维堡。

english: Aalst stands on the Dender River in East Flanders. Its recorded history reaches back to the ninth century, and its rivalry with Dendermonde farther downstream has roots in the Middle Ages.
simp_chinese: 阿尔斯特坐落于东佛兰德的登德尔河畔。当地见于九世纪文献，与下游登德尔蒙德之间的竞争可追溯至中世纪。

english: Aankwaahsakwa belongs to the country now called Indiana. The wider region is bordered by the Ohio River to the south and the Wabash to the west, with Indigenous resistance continuing into the early nineteenth century.
simp_chinese: 安夸阿萨夸属于今日称为印第安纳的地区。更广阔的地区南临俄亥俄河，西以沃巴什河为界，原住民的抵抗延续到十九世纪初。

english: The Somali approaches open toward the Arabian Sea. This northern Indian Ocean basin connects the African coast with Arabia and India. The Gulf of Aden forms its western gateway toward the Red Sea, placing these waters beside routes between several maritime regions.
simp_chinese: 索马里外海通向阿拉伯海。这一北印度洋海盆连接非洲海岸、阿拉伯与印度。亚丁湾构成西面通向红海的门户，使这些水域邻接多个航海地区之间的路线。

english:
Aarau lies on the right bank of the Aare River at the southern foot of the Jura Mountains, west of Zurich and close to the border with Solothurn. Its old town occupies a rocky outcrop where the valley narrows, a position that combined river crossing, defense, and control of routes across the Swiss plateau. The name is connected with the German Au, meaning a floodplain. Although the settlement was known by the 1240s, archaeology reveals much older activity: Neolithic objects have been found, a Bronze Age village stood near the modern railway station, and a Roman road linked Solothurn with Vindonissa.

Aarau was founded around 1240 by the counts of Kyburg. The counts died out in 1273, and Agnes of Kyburg sold their lands to Rudolf I of Habsburg, who granted Aarau city rights in 1283. The medieval town was centered on the Rore tower, later incorporated into the city hall, and protected by walls and gate towers. Its oldest surviving building, the Schlössli, predates the formal town, while most of the historic center was rebuilt or enlarged during the sixteenth century. The upper gate tower guarded the road toward Lucerne and Bern, and its long use as a jail reminds us that gates controlled both movement and justice.

The Reformation reached Aarau in 1528, when the church’s altars and images were destroyed. In the eighteenth century, German immigrants introduced cotton and silk manufacturing and contributed to a vigorous intellectual and educational life. This combination of prosperity, education, and limited political representation made the town receptive to revolutionary ideas. French troops occupied it in 1798, and on 22 March Aarau was declared the capital of the Helvetic Republic. The capital soon moved, but the episode placed a medium-sized river town at the center of Switzerland’s first modern centralized state.

Aarau remains the capital of Aargau and a market and administrative center. Its irregular old town is organized around four quarters, with painted gables, a town church built between 1471 and 1478, and a seventeenth-century Justice Fountain. Bells, mathematical instruments, cutlery, textiles, chemicals, and other manufactures gave the city an industrial profile. In a country of powerful regional cities, Aarau’s importance came from its crossing of the Aare, its role as a cantonal capital, and its ability to connect the Jura with the open Swiss plateau.
simp_chinese:
阿劳位于阿勒河右岸、侏罗山南麓，处在苏黎世以西并紧邻索洛图恩州。老城坐落在河谷收窄处的一块岩体上，既能控制渡河点，也便于设防和监视穿越瑞士高原的道路。地名与德语 Au 即泛滥平原相关。虽然聚落到1240年代才明确见于记载，当地考古却发现了新石器时代遗物、青铜时代村落遗迹，以及连接索洛图恩与温迪施的罗马道路。

阿劳约在1240年由基堡伯爵建立。1273年基堡家族绝嗣，阿格妮丝·冯·基堡把领地卖给哈布斯堡国王鲁道夫一世，鲁道夫又在1283年授予阿劳城市权。中世纪城镇以罗雷塔为中心，这座塔后来被纳入市政厅，城墙和门楼则围绕老城展开。现存最古老的建筑“小城堡”早于正式建城，大部分历史中心则在十六世纪重建或扩建。上城门塔控制通往卢塞恩和伯尔尼的道路，长期兼作监狱，说明城门不仅管理交通，也象征司法权力。

1528年，宗教改革进入阿劳，城内教堂祭坛和宗教图像被毁。十八世纪，德意志移民引入棉纺和丝织业，也推动教育与启蒙思想的发展。经济繁荣、受教育程度高而政治权利有限，使当地容易接受革命观念。1798年法军占领阿劳，3月22日，海尔维第共和国宣布以此地为首都。首都地位不久后迁走，但这一事件仍让这座中等河城短暂成为瑞士第一个现代中央国家的政治中心。

今天阿劳仍是阿尔高州首府和区域市场、行政中心。老城由四个不规则街区组成，以彩绘山墙、1471年至1478年修建的城镇教堂和十七世纪正义喷泉著称。钟铃、测量仪器、餐具、纺织、化工及其他制造业塑造了城市经济。在被苏黎世、伯尔尼和巴塞尔等大城包围的瑞士高原上，阿劳的重要性来自阿勒河渡口、州首府地位以及连接侏罗山地与开阔平原的交通角色。从基堡家族建城到海尔维第共和国首都，阿劳多次处在瑞士政治变革的交汇点。今日保存的城门、市政厅、教堂和彩绘山墙显示，它既是中世纪河畔城镇，也是依靠纺织、精密制造与州级行政继续发展的现代城市。阿勒河谷因此不仅是地形背景，也是城市政治与经济独立性的基础。

english: Aarhus began as a harbour settlement at a river mouth on eastern Jutland. It developed into a Viking-age trading centre, later gaining defensive ramparts and an influential medieval bishopric.
simp_chinese: 奥胡斯起源于日德兰东部河口的港湾聚落。它发展为维京时代贸易中心，后来拥有防御土垒与有影响力的中世纪主教区。

english: Aashbikkaashee belongs to the wider Wyoming country. Its broader landscape combines Rocky Mountain ranges and rangelands in the west with the elevated prairies of the High Plains in the east.
simp_chinese: 阿什比卡希属于怀俄明地域。更广阔的景观兼有西部落基山脉和牧地，以及东部高平原的高海拔草原。

english: Aashbiliihkupe belongs to Wyoming’s eastern High Plains country. In the wider region, high prairie meets the Rocky Mountain ranges and rangelands farther west.
simp_chinese: 阿什比利库佩属于怀俄明东部高平原地区。在更广阔的区域，高地草原与西方落基山脉及其牧地相接。

english: Aashishe belongs to the upper Missouri country of the Great Plains. In the wider grassland region, immense bison herds once ranged across prairie and steppe east of the Rocky Mountains.
simp_chinese: 阿希谢属于大平原密苏里河上游地区。在更广阔的草原区域，庞大的野牛群曾漫游于落基山脉以东的高草草原与干草原。

english: Aays belongs to the wider Texas region. Texas reaches from the Gulf of Mexico toward the interior of south-central North America, with the Rio Grande forming its boundary with Mexico.
simp_chinese: 阿伊斯属于得克萨斯地区。得克萨斯从墨西哥湾向北美中南部内陆延伸，格兰德河构成其与墨西哥之间的边界。

english: Aba al-Qur belongs to the northern Arabian country around al-Jawf. Across the wider peninsula, ancient stone tools and fossils from northwestern Arabia preserve evidence of human movement during wetter phases of the region's past.
simp_chinese: 阿巴古尔属于焦夫周围的阿拉伯北部地区。在更广阔的半岛上，阿拉伯西北部的古老石器和化石保存了过去较湿润时期人类活动的证据。

english: The Abaco Coast belongs to the Lucayan island world within the wider Caribbean region. This region includes numerous cays, reefs and banks as well as the larger islands of the West Indies.
simp_chinese: 阿巴科海岸属于广义加勒比地区的卢卡亚群岛海域。这一地区除西印度群岛的大岛外，还包含众多小沙洲、礁石与浅滩。

english: Abacoa belongs to the Abaco Islands of the northern Bahamas. The limestone islands and surrounding cays are fringed by mangrove swamps, white-sand beaches and Atlantic-facing barrier reefs.
simp_chinese: 阿巴科亚属于巴哈马北部的阿巴科群岛。石灰岩岛屿及周围小岛边缘分布着红树林沼泽、白沙滩和面向大西洋的堡礁。

english: Abadan belongs to the lower Shatt al-Arab country. In the wider estuary region, nearby Basra developed from an Arab military camp founded in 636 into an important centre of trade and scholarship.
simp_chinese: 阿巴丹属于阿拉伯河下游地区。在更广阔的河口区域，邻近巴士拉由636年建立的阿拉伯军营发展为重要贸易与学术中心。

english:
Abadeh stands on a high, fertile plain between Isfahan and Shiraz, where the roads of northern Fars meet the approaches to the central Iranian plateau. Its elevation brings cold winters despite the dryness of the surrounding country. Movement along the road binds the settlement to larger cities, while the plain provides an agricultural setting quite different from the deserts farther east.

The town is especially associated with woodcarving. Craftsmen worked pear and box wood into intricately decorated objects, creating a reputation that reached beyond Fars. Cotton embroidery and locally woven rugs add other strands to its craft tradition. Such work gives Abadeh a history that cannot be told only through the rulers of Persia: workshops and the circulation of skilled labor were also part of its connection to the wider world. Later religious movements, including the Babi and Baha'i traditions, found adherents here, adding another layer to a town situated between established urban centers.
simp_chinese:
阿巴德坐落在伊斯法罕与设拉子之间的高原沃野上，是法尔斯北部道路与伊朗中部高地通道相接的地点。周围虽然干燥，较高的海拔仍使冬季颇为寒冷。沿途往来将城镇与两座大城联系起来，平原上的农地又使这里不同于更东面的沙漠。

木雕是当地尤具辨识度的手艺，工匠利用梨木与黄杨木制作繁复装饰，使阿巴德的名声越出法尔斯。棉布刺绣和地方地毯则构成另一条工艺传统。这里的历史不仅见于波斯诸王朝的更替，也见于作坊、手艺人与成品沿道路流动的过程。较晚兴起的巴布派与巴哈伊信仰也曾在此传播，为这座位于传统城市之间的城镇增添了新的宗教层次。

english: Abadeh Tashk lies in Iran’s Fars province. Formerly the centre of a district within Neyriz County, it became the seat of the newly established Bakhtegan County in 2018.
simp_chinese: 阿巴德塔什克位于伊朗法尔斯省。这里原是内里兹县所辖地区的中心，2018年成为新设巴赫特甘县的县治。

english: Abaga is a rural settlement in the Amginsky district of Russia’s Sakha Republic. It serves as the centre of Abaginsky Rural Okrug, about twenty-five kilometres from Amga.
simp_chinese: 阿巴加是俄罗斯萨哈共和国阿姆加区的一处乡村聚落。这里是阿巴加乡的行政中心，距阿姆加约二十五公里。

english: Abagaita belongs to the upper Argun country of the Mongolian region. Its wider setting forms part of the Mongolian Plateau, whose grassy steppes sustained successive nomadic societies and the empire founded by Genghis Khan in 1206.
simp_chinese: 阿巴嘎属于蒙古地区额尔古纳河上游一带。其更广阔的环境是蒙古高原的一部分，辽阔草原孕育了历代游牧社会，以及成吉思汗于1206年建立的帝国。

english: Abaiang is a coral atoll in the northern Gilbert Islands, just north of Tarawa. Its lagoon provides sheltered anchorage behind the surrounding reef islands.
simp_chinese: 阿拜昂是吉尔伯特群岛北部的一座珊瑚环礁，位于塔拉瓦以北不远处。其潟湖受到周围礁岛遮护，可供船只停泊。

english: The Gilbert Islands form a north–south chain of coral islands and atolls. Known locally as Tungaru, they make up the eastern edge of Micronesia.
simp_chinese: 吉尔伯特群岛构成南北延伸的珊瑚岛与环礁链。当地称通加鲁，位于密克罗尼西亚东缘。

english: Abakasnk belongs to the Minusinsk country of the Yenisei region. In the wider basin, Iron Age communities produced bronze-and-iron tools and large collective burial grounds centuries before the later Russian settlements.
simp_chinese: 阿巴坎斯克属于叶尼塞区域的米努辛斯克地区。在更广阔的盆地，铁器时代社群制作青铜与铁结合的工具，并修建大型集体墓地，远早于后来的俄罗斯聚落。

english: Abala belongs to the northern Ethiopian region of Enderta. In the wider northern Horn of Africa, the ancient D'mt kingdom and later Aksum shaped the political landscape, and Christianity reached the Aksumite kingdom in AD 330.
simp_chinese: 阿巴拉属于埃塞俄比亚北部的恩德尔塔地区。在非洲之角北部这一更大地域中，古代达莫特王国与后来的阿克苏姆塑造了政治格局，基督教于公元330年传入阿克苏姆王国。

english: Abalak lies near the northern edge of the Sahel beside the Sahara. The town occupies a seasonal watercourse whose underground water remains available during the long dry season.
simp_chinese: 阿巴拉克位于萨赫勒北缘、邻近撒哈拉。城镇坐落在季节性河道上，漫长旱季期间地下仍保存着水源。

english: Abalessa stands on an ancient trans-Saharan route west of Tamanrasset. The former Ahaggar capital is known for the monumental tomb attributed to the Tuareg matriarch Tin Hinan. Traces of a Tifinagh inscription and the remains of a woman with grave furnishings make it an exceptional desert monument.
simp_chinese: 阿巴莱萨位于塔曼拉塞特以西一条古老的跨撒哈拉商路上。这座阿哈加尔旧都以被认为属于图阿雷格女祖先廷希南的宏大陵墓闻名。提非纳文字痕迹、女性遗骸与随葬品，使其成为沙漠中独特的古迹。

english: The central Saharan corridor towards Djanet approaches the Tassili n’Ajjer plateau in southeastern Algeria. This sandstone mountain region preserves extensive prehistoric rock art, and its name means “plateau of rivers”, recalling a landscape very different from the present desert.
simp_chinese: 通往贾奈特的中撒哈拉走廊接近阿尔及利亚东南部的塔西利纳杰尔高原。这片砂岩山地保存大量史前岩画，名称意为“河流高原”，令人想到与今日沙漠截然不同的古老景观。

english: Aban stands on the Aban River in the Krasnoyarsk region. First recorded in 1762, the settlement later became the administrative centre of the surrounding district.
simp_chinese: 阿班位于克拉斯诺亚尔斯克地区的阿班河畔。这里最早见于1762年的记录，后来成为周边地区的行政中心。

english: Abare I belongs to the wider Paraná country of southern Brazil. At this regional scale, the Paraná links Brazil with Paraguay and Argentina, joining the Paraguay River and eventually the Uruguay to form the Río de la Plata, a great outlet towards the Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 阿巴雷伊属于巴西南部的广义巴拉那地区。在地区尺度上，巴拉那河连接巴西、巴拉圭与阿根廷，先汇合巴拉圭河，最终与乌拉圭河共同形成通往大西洋的拉普拉塔河。

english:
Abarkuh occupies the dry highlands of central Iran, a settlement remembered both for its monuments and for an ancient living cypress. Its name was explained by the fourteenth-century geographer Hamdallah Mustawfi as meaning a place upon a mountain: he related that the original settlement had moved from a hill down to the plain. This is a historical explanation of the name, rather than a certain account of its origin.

In the eleventh century the town passed between the Buyids, Kakuyids, and the rising Seljuk power. After Tughril took Isfahan in 1051, the dispossessed Kakuyid ruler received Abarkuh and Yazd in compensation. The Gonbad-e Ali, raised in 1056 or 1057 for a member of the Firuzanid family, remains a witness to this period. Much later adobe ice houses show another response to the same environment: thick earthen structures preserved ice and food through the heat, turning knowledge of climate into a practical urban resource.
simp_chinese:
阿巴尔库位于伊朗中部干燥高地，既以古老建筑闻名，也保存着一株仍然存活的古柏。十四世纪地理学家哈姆杜拉·穆斯陶菲曾把城名解释为“山上的地方”，并说聚落原在山丘上，后来迁至平原；这是一种流传下来的地名解释，并非已经确定的词源。

十一世纪，城镇在布韦希人、卡库伊德家族与兴起的塞尔柱势力之间易手。图格里勒于1051年夺取伊斯法罕后，把阿巴尔库和亚兹德补偿给失去都城的卡库伊德统治者。1056或1057年为菲鲁赞家族成员修建的贡巴德阿里陵墓，至今见证着这个时代。较晚的土坯冰窖则记录了居民适应气候的另一种本领：依靠厚实的土墙保存冰与食物，使炎热环境中的技术经验成为城市生活的重要资源。

english:
Abashiri lies in eastern Hokkaido on the coast of the Sea of Okhotsk. The Abashiri River crosses the city, and three lakes—Abashiri, Notoro, and Tōfutsu—lie within the municipality, together with the rounded hills of the Abashiri Quasi-National Park. The land is not dominated by high mountains, but the cold sea, wetlands, and seasonal ice create a severe setting. In winter, drift ice covers the Sea of Okhotsk and closes the harbor; when Lake Abashiri freezes, fog becomes common over the surrounding lowland.

The name comes from an Ainu word, though no single explanation is certain. Proposed meanings include “leaking ground,” associated with water dripping in a cave, and phrases involving discovery or a distinctive rock. These traditions belong to the Ainu landscape of eastern Hokkaido, where fishing, hunting, plant gathering, and movement along rivers and coasts shaped settlement long before a Japanese town existed. The exact urban settlement of Abashiri dates only from the Meiji period, so its medieval history is the history of Ainu communities and of the region’s natural geography rather than a walled town.

In 1872 the Japanese state established Abashiri Village as part of its expansion and administrative organization in Hokkaido. The village became a town in 1902 after merging neighboring settlements, and a city in 1947. The Meiji government also built the famous Abashiri Prison, where political prisoners and others were confined in a remote frontier. The old prison is now a museum, while a modern maximum-security prison remains in the city.

Abashiri’s modern economy developed around fishing, timber, transport, dairy farming, and seasonal tourism. Its remoteness is now an attraction: visitors come for drift ice, the lakes, the prison heritage, and Ainu archaeological sites such as the Moyoro shell mound. The city therefore has two histories. One belongs to the long ecological and indigenous occupation of the Okhotsk coast; the other begins with the rapid late nineteenth-century creation of a Japanese municipality through settlement, transport, and state institutions. The city receives less precipitation than almost any other Japanese city because the mountains shelter it from moist southern winds. Drift ice and lake ice therefore dominate the seasonal rhythm, supporting a winter tourism economy while limiting the harbor for much of the year.
simp_chinese:
网走位于北海道东部鄂霍次克海沿岸。网走河穿过市区，网走湖、能取湖和涛沸湖三座湖泊以及网走国定公园的丘陵都位于市域内。这里没有高大连绵的山脉，寒冷的海洋、湿地和季节性海冰却形成严酷环境。冬季，鄂霍次克海漂冰覆盖海面，港口随之关闭；网走湖结冰时，周围低地又常出现浓雾。

地名来自阿伊努语，但确切含义并不确定。可能的解释包括“漏水之地”，与洞穴中滴水有关，也包括表示“我们发现之土地”或某块人形白岩的说法。这些传统属于北海道东部的阿伊努景观；在日本城镇出现以前，捕鱼、狩猎、采集以及沿河和沿海移动长期塑造当地生活。严格意义上的网走城市聚落迟至明治时期才建立，因此其中世纪历史主要是阿伊努社群与自然地理的历史，而不是一座带城墙城镇的历史。

1872年，日本国家在开拓和行政整合北海道的过程中建立网走村。1902年，网走与附近聚落合并成镇，1947年设市。明治政府还在偏远边疆修建著名的网走监狱，关押政治犯及其他囚犯。旧监狱现已成为博物馆，新式最高警戒监狱仍在使用。

网走的现代经济依赖渔业、木材、交通运输、乳牛业和季节旅游。偏远地区如今反成吸引力，游客为观赏流冰、湖泊、监狱历史和莫约罗贝冢等阿伊努考古遗址而来。城市因此拥有两段历史：一段属于鄂霍次克海岸长期的生态与原住民生活，另一段始于十九世纪后期通过移民、交通和国家机构迅速建立日本市镇。由于群山挡住来自南方的湿润风，网走降水量在全国城市中极低。流冰和湖冰因此主导季节节奏：冬季旅游依靠冰雪景观发展，港口却在一年中相当长时间受限。周边聚落合并、铁路与公路建设，也使原先分散的渔村和农场逐步纳入市域。网走的城市史因此始终围绕海洋、湖泊和季节性交通展开；自然条件既限制农业与港口，也形成独特的资源基础。阿伊努社群对地名的记忆则提醒，城市化以前这里早已存在成熟的地方知识。它的历史也由河流、湖泊与海岸共同定义。地方社会也随季节调整。

english: Abau is the centre of a wider district in Papua New Guinea’s Central Province. The district includes the rural areas of Amazon Bay, Aroma and Cloudy Bay, with Daga and Mailuan among its principal languages. These names reflect a varied Papuan coastal country of villages and neighbouring islands.
simp_chinese: 阿鲍是巴布亚新几内亚中央省一个较广地区的中心。该地区包括亚马孙湾、阿罗马与克劳迪湾乡区，达加语和迈卢语是主要语言。这些名称呈现出村落与邻近岛屿交织的多样巴布亚沿海地域。

english:
Abbeville stands on the Somme in northern France, about twenty kilometers from the modern channel mouth and roughly midway between Rouen and Lille. Most of the town occupies the east bank and an island in the river. In the Middle Ages this was the lowest dependable crossing of the Somme before the estuary, making the town a gateway between maritime Picardy, Amiens, and the road network of northern France. Abbeville served as the capital of the County of Ponthieu, and its control of the crossing gave it strategic value beyond the size of its population.

War repeatedly passed through the town. In 1346 the army of Edward III crossed the Somme near Abbeville shortly before defeating the French at Crécy. The river also carried commerce and supported a port, canal, and river shipping, but silt eventually reduced the navigable approach. Abbeville’s central location made it a regular stopping place for kings and diplomats. On 3 October 1514 Louis XII married Mary Tudor there, and in 1517 Francis I met Cardinal Wolsey at Abbeville while negotiating the alliance that became the Treaty of London.

The seventeenth century brought both manufacturing and religious conflict. Under Louis XIV, Colbert encouraged the Van Robais family of Dutch textile makers to settle in Abbeville. In 1665 they founded the Manufacture royale des Rames, producing fine linens and tablecloths and making the town a center of royal drapery production. The revocation of the Edict of Nantes in 1685 then destroyed the Protestant temple and drove away many skilled workers, including people employed by the Van Robais. The population and cloth industry suffered a blow from which the old river economy did not fully recover.

Abbeville remained a regional administrative and market center. Its position on the Somme explains the medieval castle, the canal, the bridges, and the density of shipping and mills, while its later railway links connected it to Boulogne, Amiens, Calais, and Paris. The historic center preserves traces of the county capital, the royal visits, the textile workshops, and the churches rebuilt after centuries of war. For the EU5 era, Abbeville is best understood as a river crossing and textile town whose fortunes rose and fell with the Somme, the Channel, and the religious politics of the French crown.
simp_chinese:
阿布维尔位于法国北部索姆河畔，距离今日英吉利海峡河口约二十公里，大致处于鲁昂与里尔之间。城区大部分位于河东岸及一座河岛。中世纪时，这里是索姆河进入河口前最低而可靠的一处渡口，因此成为滨海皮卡第、亚眠与北法道路网之间的门户。阿布维尔也是蓬蒂厄伯爵领首府，对渡口的控制使它的战略价值远高于城市规模。

战争屡次经过此地。1346年，爱德华三世的军队在阿布维尔附近渡过索姆河，随后在克雷西击败法军。河流同样承载商业，维系港口、运河与河运，但泥沙淤积后来削弱了通往大海的航道。居中的位置使阿布维尔成为国王和外交使节经常停留的地方。1514年10月3日，路易十二在此与英格兰的玛丽·都铎成婚；1517年，弗朗索瓦一世又在阿布维尔会见枢机沃尔西，商谈后来形成《伦敦条约》的联盟。

十七世纪既带来制造业，也带来宗教冲突。路易十四时期，柯尔贝尔招引荷兰纺织家族范罗拜迁居阿布维尔。1665年，他们建立王家呢绒工场，生产精细亚麻布和桌布，使城市成为王室织物制造中心。1685年《枫丹白露敕令》撤销《南特敕令》后，新教教堂被毁，大量熟练工匠外迁，范罗拜工场也受到打击。人口和纺织业长期未能完全恢复，旧有的河港经济由此衰退。

阿布维尔后来仍是区域行政和市场中心。索姆河的位置解释了中世纪城堡、运河、桥梁以及磨坊和航运密集的原因，铁路时代又把它同布洛涅、亚眠、加来和巴黎连接起来。历史城区保存着伯爵领首府、王室访问、纺织工场以及战后重建教堂的痕迹。放在 EU5 时代看，阿布维尔是一座由渡口与纺织业维生的河城，它的兴衰同时受到索姆河、英吉利海峡和法国王权宗教政策的影响。阿布维尔的命运始终同索姆河联系在一起：渡口使它成为伯爵领中心，河港带动贸易，泥沙却削弱航运；王室联姻与外交会议带来荣耀，宗教迫害和熟练工匠外流又让纺织业受损。这些变化共同塑造了一座北法河城的多重身份。它也是一座在海洋贸易与大陆农业之间转换角色的边境城市。

english: The waters around Abd al Kuri lie near the western approaches of the Arabian Sea. This northern Indian Ocean basin connects westward through the Gulf of Aden towards the Red Sea.
simp_chinese: 阿卜杜勒库里周围水域接近阿拉伯海西部入口。这片印度洋北部海盆向西经亚丁湾通往红海。

english: Abd al-Kuri belongs to the Socotra archipelago off southern Arabia. In modern history the archipelago formed part of South Yemen, whose territories included the southern and eastern parts of present-day Yemen before unification in 1990.
simp_chinese: 阿卜杜勒库里岛属于阿拉伯南部外海的索科特拉群岛。近代群岛曾属南也门，其领土包括今也门南部与东部，直至1990年统一。

english: Abdanan lies in Iran's Ilam region. The town's population includes Kurdish communities and a Lur minority.
simp_chinese: 阿布达南位于伊朗伊拉姆地区。城镇居民包括库尔德社群和少数卢尔人。

english: Abdas belongs to the Basra region of southern Iraq. The regional port of Basra stands on the Shatt al-Arab, which flows into the Persian Gulf, and developed from a seventh-century military camp into a major centre of trade and learning.
simp_chinese: 阿布达斯属于伊拉克南部巴士拉地区。地区港口巴士拉坐落在流入波斯湾的阿拉伯河畔，由7世纪的军营发展为重要的贸易与学术中心。

english: Abdulino lies in the Orenburg region of Russia. The modern town serves as the administrative centre of its surrounding district, while retaining a separate town administration.
simp_chinese: 阿卜杜利诺位于俄罗斯奥伦堡地区。现代城镇是周围县域的行政中心，同时保留单独的市级行政地位。

english: Abe belongs to Suruga in the Tōkaidō region. This ancient circuit linked provincial capitals by a chain of roads; in the Edo period its main highway became Japan’s most important route, binding the eastern provinces to the old centres of power.
simp_chinese: 安倍属于东海道地区的骏河。这个古老道域以连续道路连接各国国府；江户时代，其主干道路成为日本最重要的交通线，将东部诸国与古老权力中心联系起来。

english: New Brunswick faces the Gulf of Saint Lawrence to the northeast. Its other maritime shore opens southeast into the Bay of Fundy.
simp_chinese: 新不伦瑞克东北面向圣劳伦斯湾。另一侧的海岸向东南通入芬迪湾。

english: Abemama is an atoll in Kiribati’s Gilbert Islands, just north of the equator and southeast of Tarawa. Its islets enclose a deep lagoon, with smaller outlying islands on the western side.
simp_chinese: 阿贝马马是基里巴斯吉尔伯特群岛中的一座环礁，位于赤道以北、塔拉瓦东南方。各小岛围成一座深潟湖，西侧另有较小的离岛。

english: The Gilbert Islands form a north–south chain of sixteen atolls and reef islands. Known locally as Tungaru, they straddle the equator in the easternmost part of Micronesia.
simp_chinese: 吉尔伯特群岛由十六座环礁及珊瑚岛组成南北向岛链。当地称通加鲁，跨越密克罗尼西亚最东部的赤道。

english: Abengourou lies in eastern Côte d’Ivoire. The area is predominantly Anyi, part of the Akan cultural world, and its agricultural hinterland produces cocoa and coffee for trade towards the coast.
simp_chinese: 阿本古鲁位于科特迪瓦东部。当地以属于阿肯文化世界的阿尼人为主，农业腹地生产可可与咖啡，经贸易运往沿海。

english: Aberdeen gives its name to the historic county of Aberdeenshire in northeastern Scotland. The surrounding country extends toward Kincardineshire and Banffshire, while the modern city forms a separate administrative area.
simp_chinese: 阿伯丁是苏格兰东北部历史郡阿伯丁郡名称的来源。周围地区延伸至金卡丁郡与班夫郡一带，现代城市则构成独立行政区域。

english: Aberdeen Lake is an irregular lake on the Canadian Shield in Nunavut’s Kivalliq region. A central peninsula nearly divides its long basin in two. The Thelon River enters and leaves it, linking Beverly Lake upstream with Schultz Lake downstream.
simp_chinese: 阿伯丁湖是努纳武特基瓦利克地区加拿大地盾上的不规则湖泊。中央半岛几乎将其狭长湖盆分为两半。塞隆河流入并流出该湖，将上游贝弗利湖与下游舒尔茨湖联系起来。

english: Aberfeldy belongs to Perthshire, the broad historic county of central Scotland. The wider country stretches from the agricultural straths of the east toward Rannoch Moor and the mountain approaches around Drumochter.
simp_chinese: 阿伯费尔迪属于苏格兰中部广阔的历史郡珀斯郡。更广阔的地区从东部农业河谷延伸至兰诺赫荒原以及德鲁莫赫特周边的山地通路。

english: Aberystwyth Castle was built in the late thirteenth century after Edward I’s first Welsh war. Owain Glyndŵr’s supporters captured it in 1404, before the English recovered it four years later.
simp_chinese: 阿伯里斯特威斯城堡建于十三世纪末，即爱德华一世第一次威尔士战争之后。欧文·格林杜尔的支持者于1404年夺取城堡，四年后英军将其收复。

english: Abesehir belongs to the Wadai country of northern Central Africa. In the wider Lake Chad world, successive civilizations and kingdoms including Sao, Kanem, Bornu and Wadai emerged within a long history of settlement and exchange.
simp_chinese: 阿贝谢希尔属于中非北部的瓦达伊地区。在更广阔的乍得湖世界，萨奥、加涅姆、博尔努与瓦达伊等文明和王国先后兴起，延续着悠久的定居与交换历史。

english: Abha lies high in the fertile Asir Mountains of southwestern Arabia. At about 2,270 metres above sea level, its mild climate contrasts with the much hotter lowlands.
simp_chinese: 艾卜哈位于阿拉伯半岛西南部肥沃的阿西尔山地。其海拔约2270米，温和气候与炎热得多的低地形成对照。

english: Abhar lies between Qazvin and Zanjan in Iran. Its name is linked to water mills, while the tenth-century geography Hudud al-Alam records the form Awhar still used locally.
simp_chinese: 阿卜哈尔位于伊朗加兹温与赞詹之间。其名称与水磨有关，10世纪地理著作《世界境域志》已记有当地仍使用的Awhar这一形式。

english:
Abihka belonged to the river country of the upper Coosa and Alabama, within the homeland of the Upper Creek peoples. Its exact town site remains uncertain, so the name is best understood as referring to a community and its surrounding territory rather than a precisely identified surviving settlement. It was counted among the mother towns of the Muscogee confederacy, and the name was sometimes extended to the Upper Creeks more broadly.

The community inherited connections with the sixteenth-century chiefdom of Coosa. In the eighteenth century Natchez refugees, scattered by French expansion and warfare, settled among the Abihka. By 1771 European traders were also living in the town. These changes made the river settlements places where older political traditions met displaced peoples and new commercial relationships. After removal to Indian Territory, descendants established a ceremonial ground bearing the Abihka or Arbeka name near present-day Henryetta, preserving an attachment to the community beyond its original homeland.
simp_chinese:
阿比卡属于库萨河上游与阿拉巴马河一带的河川地域，是上克里克诸社群故土的一部分。原城镇的确切位置尚未确定，因此这个名称更适合指称一支社群及其周围土地，而非某个已被精确找到的遗址。它是穆斯科吉联盟的母镇之一，名称有时也被扩大用于称呼上克里克人。

这支社群承接了十六世纪库萨酋邦的历史联系。十八世纪，受法国扩张与战争驱散的纳切兹难民迁来与他们共同生活；至1771年，欧洲商人也已在镇中居住。河畔聚落由此成为旧有政治传统、迁徙人群与新商业联系交会的地方。后来居民被迫迁往印第安领地，后裔又在今亨利埃塔附近建立名为阿比卡或阿尔贝卡的仪式场地，使社群认同在离开故土后仍得以延续。

english: Abil belongs to Asir, the rugged country of southern Arabia. The region’s name has several proposed origins: one links it to difficult terrain, while another connects it with the influence of the Banu Asir and their ruling families.
simp_chinese: 阿比勒属于阿拉伯半岛南部崎岖的阿西尔地区。其名称起源有多种解释：一种联系难行的地形，另一种则联系巴努阿西尔部族及其统治家族的影响。

english: Abimatinu belongs to the Moose River country near western James Bay. The wider district’s hub, Moosonee, developed around a Revillon Frères fur post founded in 1903. Boats connect it with the older Moose Factory community, while winter ice roads replace summer crossings.
simp_chinese: 阿比马蒂努属于詹姆斯湾西侧附近的穆斯河地区。广阔地区的枢纽穆索尼，围绕1903年创建的雷维永兄弟毛皮贸易站发展起来。船只将其与更古老的穆斯法克托里社群相连，冬季冰路则替代夏日渡行。

english: Abingdon is an old market town beside the Thames in the historic county of Berkshire. Its abbey was founded around 676, and the town later developed a substantial medieval trade in wool and cloth.
simp_chinese: 阿宾登是历史上伯克郡境内泰晤士河畔的一座古老集镇。修道院约建于676年，城镇后来发展出颇具规模的中世纪羊毛与织物贸易。

english:
Abisko lies beside the great lake Tornetrask in the northern Scandinavian mountains, well north of the Arctic Circle. This is part of Sapmi, the broad northern homeland whose geography crosses later national boundaries. The settlement overlooks a landscape of water, steep slopes, and open mountain valleys; the conspicuous U-shaped gap known as Lapporten is one of its best-known landmarks.

The mountains give the district an unusual climate. Moist air arriving from the Atlantic loses much of its precipitation before reaching Abisko, making this a dry pocket within an otherwise severe northern environment. The long light of summer and the dark winters shape travel and the rhythm of life. In later times the Kiruna-Narvik railway and mountain trails drew travelers through the area, while a scientific station made it a center for Arctic ecological research. These newer uses rest upon the same enduring feature: Abisko is a meeting place of lake country, mountain passage, and the contrasting influences of ocean and continental interior.
simp_chinese:
阿比斯库坐落在斯堪的纳维亚北部山区，毗邻辽阔的托尔讷湖，位置远在北极圈以北。这里属于萨普米地域，其地理联系跨越了后来划定的国界。湖水、陡坡与开阔山谷共同构成聚落周围的景观，远处呈U形的“拉普门”山口尤为醒目。

山脉也造成了特殊气候：来自大西洋的湿润空气在翻越山地时失去大量降水，使阿比斯库成为严寒北方环境中一个相对干燥的角落。夏季漫长的日照与冬季的黑暗影响着出行和生活节奏。较晚修建的基律纳—纳尔维克铁路和登山步道把旅人带入此地，科学站又使其成为北极生态研究中心。这些新用途始终建立在同一种地理条件上：这里是湖区、山地通道与海洋和大陆气候影响相会的地点。

english: Abitau belongs to the wider Dubawnt lake country of northern Canada. Dubawnt Lake drains north through its namesake river to the Thelon. The lake lies near the traditional contact zone between Sayisi Dene and Caribou Inuit communities.
simp_chinese: 阿比托属于加拿大北部广义的杜邦特湖区。杜邦特湖经同名河流向北排水，汇入锡隆河。湖泊位于萨伊西德内人与驯鹿因纽特群体的传统接触地带附近。

english: The Abitibi Uplands belong to the forested country drained by the Abitibi River toward the Moose and James Bay. The river became an important Hudson’s Bay Company fur route, while its Algonquin name recalls water halfway between the Hudson Bay and Ottawa trading worlds.
simp_chinese: 阿比蒂比高地属于阿比蒂比河经穆斯河流向詹姆斯湾的森林地区。河流成为哈德逊湾公司的重要毛皮通道，其阿尔冈昆语名称令人想起哈德逊湾与渥太华贸易网络之间的中途水域。

english:
Abiward stood on the northern edge of Greater Khorasan, in the foothill belt known as Etek. Together with Nisa and Serakhs it belonged to a chain of Iranian frontier settlements facing the mobile peoples of Inner Asia. Its importance came from this position between cultivated country and the routes of the steppe, rather than from the size of its surviving ruins alone.

The city is associated with the Sasanian period, and medieval geographical writers remembered both its developed agriculture and the martial reputation of its inhabitants. Such descriptions fit a community whose fields and defenses were closely linked. A fortified mound and the remains of a congregational mosque preserve traces of its urban life. The mosque's collapse in the nineteenth century and the later work of archaeology remind visitors that the visible site represents only part of a much longer history. Abiward offers a view of Khorasan from its border: irrigation and farming sustained settlement, while the possibility of raids made the frontier a permanent concern.
simp_chinese:
阿比瓦尔德位于大呼罗珊北缘、名为埃泰克的山麓地带，与尼萨、萨拉赫斯一起构成面向内亚游动人群的伊朗边境聚落链。它的重要性来自耕作地域与草原道路之间的位置，不能仅从今日遗址的大小判断。

城市的历史可追溯至萨珊时代，中世纪地理作者既提到当地较发达的农业，也记述居民尚武的名声。田地与防御紧密相连，正是这种边境生活的写照。筑有防御设施的土丘及聚礼清真寺遗迹，保留着昔日城市活动的痕迹。清真寺在十九世纪倒塌，后来考古逐渐揭示其结构，说明眼前所见只是漫长城市史的一部分。阿比瓦尔德展示了呼罗珊的另一面：农业维持定居，而来自边境的袭扰又使防卫成为始终不能忽视的事务。

english:
Abiy Addi lies in central Tigray at an elevation of roughly 1,950 meters, at the southeastern edge of the Kola Tembien district. The Tanqwa River divides the settlement into two parts, with the marketplace and most commercial activity in the upper section. The town sits in a dusty valley below a high cliff, and to the west the land drops into the deep Tekezé valley before rising toward the Simien Mountains. Its mountain setting gives access to grazing, honey, grain, and highland produce, while routes through Tembien connect the northern Ethiopian interior with regional markets.

The name means “big town,” and Abiy Addi’s importance came above all from its market. British explorer Charles Beke passed through in April 1843 and called it the principal place of Tembien and a large market town. A Saturday market assembled people from surrounding highlands and lowlands. Local honey and the energetic Awri dance are associated with the town’s cultural reputation, but the main historical record concerns exchange: livestock, grain, cloth, salt, tools, and news moving between communities that otherwise lived in difficult mountain terrain.

Long-distance trade reached Abiy Addi even in the late nineteenth century. Visitors in 1890 noted mirrors made in France, cotton cloth from Manchester and Mumbai, and ordinary local produce in the same market. These imports reveal how Red Sea ports, colonial merchant networks, and Indian Ocean textiles penetrated the Ethiopian highlands before railways or motor roads. The town’s size fluctuated with political security and famine. By the early twentieth century it had expanded again, but the twentieth-century wars and the Derg period brought occupation, air attacks, and displacement.

Abiy Addi remains the administrative center of Kola Tembien and a regional market. Its position between the Tanqwa, the Tekezé valley, and the highlands of Tembien explains both its commercial role and its vulnerability. The town’s history is not dominated by palaces or major monuments; it is a history of market days, mountain roads, imported cloth, local honey, and the ability of a highland settlement to connect scattered communities. Geologically, the town spans elevations from about 1,917 to 2,275 meters and lies across Ashangi basalts, Amba Aradam formations, Adigrat sandstone, and older glacial deposits. The varied strata help form springs, escarpments, and the dramatic valley views that define the approach to the town.
simp_chinese:
阿比阿迪位于提格雷中部，海拔约1950米，处在科拉滕本地区东南边缘。坦夸河把城镇分成两部分，市场和大部分商业活动位于较高的区域。城镇坐落在高崖下方的尘土谷地，向西地势下降至深切的特克泽河谷，再向远处的瑟门山抬升。山地环境提供牧场、蜂蜜、谷物和高原物产，穿越滕本的道路又把北埃塞俄比亚内陆同区域市场连接起来。

地名意为“大城镇”，阿比阿迪的重要性首先来自集市。英国探险者查尔斯·贝克在1843年4月经过，称这里是滕本的主要地点和大型市场城镇。星期六集市会聚集周边高地与低地居民。当地蜂蜜和节奏强烈的 Awri 舞蹈构成文化声誉，但历史记录最重要的部分是交换：牲畜、谷物、布匹、盐、工具和消息在交通困难的山地社群间流通。

十九世纪后期，长途贸易已经深入阿比阿迪。1890年的访客在市场里看到法国制造的镜子、来自曼彻斯特和孟买的棉布以及普通地方物产。这些商品说明，在铁路和汽车道路出现以前，红海港口、殖民商业网络和印度洋纺织贸易已经进入埃塞俄比亚高原。城镇规模随政治安全、饥荒和战争反复变化；二十世纪意大利占领、阿比西尼亚战争和德尔格政权的空袭又造成破坏与人口流离。

今日阿比阿迪仍是科拉滕本行政中心与区域市场。它位于坦夸河、特克泽谷地和滕本高地之间，这一位置既造就商业作用，也带来脆弱性。城市历史并不以宫殿或宏大建筑为主，而由集市日、山道、进口棉布、本地蜂蜜以及高地聚落连接分散社群的能力构成。地质上，阿比阿迪海拔约在1917米至2275米之间，地表跨越阿尚吉玄武岩、安巴阿拉丹地层、阿迪格拉特砂岩与更古老冰川沉积。不同岩层帮助形成泉水、陡崖以及进入城镇时可见的深谷景观，也影响道路和聚落的稳定性。集市的兴衰也说明山地城镇的安全依赖远超个人努力：道路畅通、政治保护、进口商品供应和周边农户收成缺一不可。阿比阿迪因此在平静时期能聚集两千人交易，在战争与饥荒时又会迅速萎缩。高海拔与市场传统共同塑造了这座城镇的韧性。

english: Abiz belongs to the Qaen country of eastern Iran. The wider regional centre appears in the Middle Persian Shahrestaniha i Eranshahr, where its foundation is attributed to a legendary king.
simp_chinese: 阿比兹属于伊朗东部的加延地区。更广阔区域的中心见于中古波斯文《伊朗诸城》，其中将其建立归于一位传说君王。

english:
Turku stands where the Aura River reaches the sea on the southwestern coast of Finland. Known as Åbo in Swedish, it is Finland’s oldest city and remains a bilingual municipality. Its Finnish name is associated with an old trade word for market, while Åbo is commonly understood as a dwelling by a river. These two names describe the same essential setting: a sheltered coastal meeting place whose livelihood depended on waterborne exchange.

People lived around Turku long before the medieval town appeared. Post-glacial uplift gradually turned an offshore archipelago into a populated shoreline, and the region was among Finland’s most important agricultural districts during the Iron Age. Cemeteries in use from roughly 550 to 1150 reveal communities shaped by migration, the Viking Age, and the coming of Christianity. A port was developing by the eleventh century. Al-Idrisi’s world map of 1154 may identify Turku, and Pope Gregory IX mentioned the town as Aboa in a bull of 1229, the date now used for its foundation.

Turku became the political and ecclesiastical center of Swedish Finland. Turku Castle and the cathedral anchored royal and church power, while the surrounding region supplied much of the Finnish word’s early significance as “Finland Proper.” Duke John, the future John III of Sweden, governed Finland from the castle. The Reformation arrived through the cathedral school: its bishop Mikael Agricola became known as the father of written Finnish. Turku also suffered the Åbo Bloodbath after the war between Sigismund and Duke Charles, and in 1640 Queen Christina founded the Royal Academy, Finland’s first university.

The Finnish portion of the Swedish realm passed to Russia in 1809 and became an autonomous grand duchy. Turku briefly served as its capital from 1809 until Emperor Alexander I moved the seat of government to Helsinki in 1812. After the great fire of 1827, the Royal Academy and many institutions also moved east, establishing Helsinki’s cultural predominance. Turku remained the regional capital and important port. Its dense medieval core, riverfront, castle and cathedral preserve the long history of a city that was once both the gateway and the administrative heart of Finland.
simp_chinese:
图尔库位于芬兰西南海岸，奥拉河在此流入波罗的海。它在瑞典语中名为 Åbo，是芬兰最古老的城市，也是一座至今仍以芬兰语和瑞典语并行的双语城市。芬兰语名称与古老的“市场”贸易词相联系，瑞典语名称通常被理解成河畔居所。两个名字指向同一个根本特征：一处依托水运和交换而生的沿海聚落。

早在中世纪城镇出现以前，图尔库周边已经有人定居。冰期后的地壳抬升逐渐把近海群岛变成可居住的海岸，当地也成为芬兰铁器时代最重要的农业区域之一。约550年至1150年间持续使用的墓地，反映出迁徙、维京时代与基督教传播留下的多重影响。到十一世纪，图尔库一带已出现港口。1154年伊德里西绘制的世界地图可能标出了图尔库；1229年教皇格里高利九世在教谕中提到 Aboa，这一年后来被视作图尔库的建城年份。

此后，图尔库逐渐成为瑞典统治下芬兰的政治和宗教中心。图尔库城堡、主教座堂与教会学校共同构成权力核心，周边地区也长期保有“芬兰本部”的地位。古斯塔夫·瓦萨之子约翰曾以芬兰公爵身份在图尔库城堡治理领地，后来成为瑞典国王约翰三世。宗教改革则通过主教座堂学校传播，曾主持该校、后任图尔库主教的米卡埃尔·阿格里科拉被视为芬兰书面语言之父。西吉斯蒙德战争之后，图尔库又发生了血洗事件。1640年，克里斯蒂娜女王在此建立王家学院，这是芬兰第一所大学。

1809年，瑞典王国的芬兰部分并入俄国，成为享有自治权的大公国。图尔库在1809年至1812年间短暂担任大公国首都；随后亚历山大一世把政府迁往赫尔辛基。1827年大火之后，王家学院及大量机构也迁往新的首都，赫尔辛基的文化优势由此确立。图尔库仍是区域行政中心和重要港口。它的中世纪街巷、河岸、城堡与主教座堂，保存着一座曾同时充当芬兰门户与政治心脏的城市的漫长记忆。作为芬兰最古老的城市，图尔库保存的不只是建筑，更是一套从铁器时代沿岸聚落、瑞典王权与宗教改革，到俄国大公国时代首都竞争的历史层序。它也是芬兰国家形成以前，波罗的海东部城市网络的重要节点。

english: The northern Baltic waters belong to the world’s largest brackish-water basin. Limited exchange with the Atlantic occurs through the Danish straits, linking the archipelago coast with the Baltic’s southern approaches.
simp_chinese: 波罗的海北部水域属于世界最大的半咸水海盆。与大西洋的有限交换通过丹麦海峡发生，将群岛海岸与波罗的海南部通道相连。

english:
Abomey lies on a plateau in what is now southern Benin, about 221 meters above the lowland corridor toward the Atlantic. In Fon it is called Agbome, and the city grew from the older village of Kana to become the capital of the Kingdom of Dahomey in the seventeenth century. Its position on the plateau offered defensible ground, while the surrounding farming country and routes toward the coast supported a capital that increasingly projected power beyond its own fields.

Dahomey developed among the Fon people around 1600 as an offshoot of the royal line of Allada. The modern lists of kings usually begin with Do-Aklin, but Houegbadja, who ruled from about 1645 to 1685, is credited with building the Royal Palaces of Abomey and extending raids beyond the plateau. The palaces formed a walled royal quarter of courtyards, audience halls, shrines, and houses associated with successive rulers. Their earthen architecture and bas-reliefs recorded victories, royal symbols, and religious ideas, and UNESCO later recognized the ensemble as a World Heritage Site.

King Agaja transformed Dahomey into a regional power. In 1724 he conquered Allada, the ancestral kingdom of the dynasty, and in 1727 he took Whydah on the coast. Access to that port tied Abomey directly to Atlantic commerce. Dahomey became a major supplier of enslaved people, exchanging captives taken in wars and raids for firearms, powder, cloth, cowries, tobacco, pipes, and alcohol. The trade financed an army of roughly ten thousand and a highly militarized state, while captives were also used on royal plantations. Political power centered on the palace, appointing officials, taxing trade, and managing relations with coastal intermediaries and foreign merchants.

The expansion brought repeated conflict with the Oyo Empire, which forced Dahomey into tributary status for much of the eighteenth century. King Ghezo recovered independence from Oyo in 1823 and expanded the use of palm oil as British pressure mounted against the slave trade. Dahomey remained famous for its female military corps, commonly called the Amazons. By the 1840s Abomey had perhaps twenty-four thousand inhabitants, but defeat by Abeokuta and European abolition campaigns weakened the kingdom. France went to war in 1890 and again in 1892. On 16 November 1892 King Behanzin set fire to the capital and fled north. Abomey lost its political centrality after the French built Bohicon nearby, yet its palaces remain the strongest physical record of one of West Africa’s most powerful states.
simp_chinese:
阿波美位于今日贝宁南部的阿波美高原，海拔约221米，俯临通往大西洋的低地走廊。它在丰语中称 Agbome，最初由卡纳村发展而来，十七世纪成为达荷美王国的都城。高原提供了相对易守的地势，周边农耕区域和通向海岸的道路，则支撑一个逐渐把权力伸向海上的都城。

达荷美约在1600年由丰人建立，王室源出阿拉达。后世王表通常从多阿克兰开始，但约1645年至1685年在位的乌埃格巴贾被视为阿波美王宫的主要营建者，并开始向高原之外征伐。王宫由院落、议事厅、神庙以及历代国王营建的居所组成，形成带围墙的宫廷区域。泥筑建筑和浮雕记录王朝胜利、王权象征与宗教信仰，联合国教科文组织后来把阿波美王宫列入世界遗产。

阿加贾国王使达荷美崛起为地区强权。1724年，他征服王族祖先所在的阿拉达王国；1727年又夺取海岸上的维达。控制港口后，阿波美直接卷入大西洋贸易。达荷美成为奴隶出口的重要供应者，把战争和袭击中俘获的人交换成火器、火药、织物、贝币、烟草、烟斗和酒。奴隶贸易为约一万人的常备军和高度军事化的国家提供财力，被俘者也被用于王室种植园。宫廷通过任命官员、征收商税并同海岸中间商和外国商人交涉来统合权力。

扩张也使达荷美与奥约帝国长期战争，并在十八世纪大部分时间沦为奥约的朝贡国。盖佐国王于1823年摆脱奥约控制，在英国反奴隶贸易压力增强时扩大棕榈油贸易。达荷美还因女性军团而闻名，欧洲人通常称她们为“达荷美亚马逊”。到1840年代，阿波美约有2.4万居民，但阿贝奥库塔的击败与欧洲废奴行动削弱了王国。法国在1890年和1892年先后发动战争。1892年11月16日，贝汉津国王焚城并北逃。法国随后在东侧建立博希孔行政中心，阿波美失去政治中心地位；保存下来的王宫则仍是西非最强大国家之一最直接的历史见证。对今天的游客而言，宫殿不仅是王朝艺术与权力的纪念物，也保存了达荷美在跨大西洋奴隶贸易、军事扩张和殖民征服中的复杂记忆。阿波美高原的城镇与王宫因此成为理解几内亚湾内陆政治与海洋贸易联系的重要地点。

english: Abong-Mbang lies in Cameroon’s eastern region at a crossroads leading toward Lomié. It serves as the administrative center of Haut-Nyong, between Yaoundé and Bertoua.
simp_chinese: 阿邦姆邦位于喀麦隆东部，坐落在通向洛米耶的道路交汇处。它是上尼永省的行政中心，处于雅温得与贝尔图阿之间。

english:
Aborlan belongs to the island of Palawan, a landscape in which indigenous communities, rivers, and later agricultural settlements overlap. Its recorded local traditions include a legendary chief, Biarongbarongan, and the exploits of his son Palaysegen. These stories should be understood as part of the community's remembered world rather than a literal chronology of rulers and battles.

The modern town was organized in 1910 during American rule. It was initially treated as a reservation where Christian settlement was restricted, with teachers among the exceptions. A plebiscite in 1916 allowed Tagbanua inhabitants to elect their own mayor and vice mayor, an episode that reveals the continuing importance of indigenous institutions beneath colonial administration. The agricultural college founded here later grew into Western Philippines University. Even the origin of Aborlan's name has several popular explanations, including a sacred tree and a story about wild boars. Together these traditions give the place a history formed by local memory, encounters with outside government, and the cultivation of Palawan's land.
simp_chinese:
阿博尔兰属于巴拉望岛，河流、原住民社群与后来的农业聚落在此交织。当地传说讲述超自然首领比阿龙巴龙安及其子帕莱塞根的经历；这些故事体现社群保存自身记忆的方式，不能直接当作统治者与战争的真实年表。

现代城镇于美国统治时期的1910年设立，最初被组织成限制基督徒移入的保留地，教师是少数例外。1916年的公民投票使塔格巴努亚居民得以自行选举镇长与副镇长，显示殖民行政之下原住民社群仍保有重要地位。此地的农业学校后来发展为西菲律宾大学。阿博尔兰一名也有多种民间解释，有的关联神树，有的关联野猪。地方传说、外来政权与土地耕作共同塑造了这片巴拉望地域的历史。

english: Ábrahámtelke was the medieval settlement on Csepel Island that preceded Ráckeve. Its twelfth-century monastery first appears in a surviving official mention in 1212. During the fifteenth century, Serbian refugees escaping Ottoman expansion settled here and gave the place names recalling Kovin, the town they had left to the south. A Serbian Orthodox monastery was built in 1487, and the settlement became a substantial mercantile town in the following century. Ottoman rule began in 1541 and drove many inhabitants northwards; later, Csepel Island passed to Prince Eugene of Savoy, whose residence marked another transformation of the old riverside community.
simp_chinese: 亚伯拉罕泰尔凯是切佩尔岛上的中世纪聚落，也是后来拉茨凯韦的前身。当地十二世纪修建的修道院，最早于1212年见于现存官方记载。十五世纪，逃避奥斯曼扩张的塞尔维亚难民来到这里，并用使人想起南方故乡科温的名称称呼此地。1487年，一座塞尔维亚正教修道院建成，聚落在接下来的世纪成为颇具规模的商镇。1541年开始的奥斯曼统治使许多居民北迁；后来，切佩尔岛归于萨伏依的欧根亲王，其宅邸又标志着这个古老河畔社群的一次转变。

english: The Abruzzo shore faces the Adriatic between Italy and the Balkans. This northern arm of the Mediterranean leads southeast towards the Strait of Otranto, with deeper basins beyond its shallow northern waters.
simp_chinese: 阿布鲁佐海岸面向意大利与巴尔干之间的亚得里亚海。这一地中海北部支海向东南通往奥特朗托海峡，浅水北部之外则分布更深的海盆。

english: Abu lies in northeastern Yamaguchi, facing the Sea of Japan. Its territory combines the coastal Nago area with Udago and the mountain country of Fukuga.
simp_chinese: 阿武位于山口东北部，面向日本海。其范围包括沿海的奈古地区、宇田乡，以及山地中的福贺。

english: The waters around Abu Abyad lie within the Persian Gulf. The wider gulf contains rich fishing grounds, reefs and pearl oysters. Hormuz provides its narrow connection to the Gulf of Oman and the Indian Ocean beyond.
simp_chinese: 阿布艾卜耶德周边水域位于波斯湾内。广大海湾拥有丰富渔场、礁石与珍珠贝。霍尔木兹提供通向阿曼湾及外部印度洋的狭窄联系。

english: The Muscat coast faces the Gulf of Oman between Arabia and the Makran shore. This sea connects the Arabian Sea with Hormuz and the Persian Gulf, making it a natural link between adjoining maritime regions.
simp_chinese: 马斯喀特海岸面向阿拉伯与马克兰海岸之间的阿曼湾。这片海域连接阿拉伯海、霍尔木兹及波斯湾，成为相邻海洋地区的天然纽带。

english: Abu Dhabi occupies an island projecting into the Persian Gulf. A Bani Yas settlement developed after fresh water was discovered in 1761, and pearl diving became an important livelihood long before the rise of the oil economy.
simp_chinese: 阿布扎比坐落在伸入波斯湾的一座岛上。1761年发现淡水后，巴尼亚斯部族在此建立聚落；在石油经济兴起之前，采珠长期是重要生计。

english: These Qatari coastal waters belong to the Persian Gulf. Fishing grounds, reefs and pearl oysters formed important marine resources within this sea between Arabia and Iran.
simp_chinese: 这片卡塔尔沿岸水域属于波斯湾。阿拉伯与伊朗之间的海洋中，渔场、礁石与珍珠牡蛎构成重要海洋资源。

english: Abu Hamed stands on the Nile's right bank within its great S-shaped bend, where desert routes approach the river. An old caravan road led across the Nubian Desert toward Korosko. The town takes its name from a revered sheikh buried here. Travellers were said to leave surplus belongings beside his tomb before crossing the desert, trusting the shrine's sanctity to protect them. A later visitor found a mud fortress with round corner bastions near the settlement. River, caravan and sacred refuge together explain the importance of this seemingly austere place.
simp_chinese: 阿布哈米德位于尼罗河大S形弯道中的右岸，是沙漠道路通向河流的地方。一条旧商队路线穿过努比亚沙漠，前往科罗斯科。城镇得名于葬在这里的一位受敬仰谢赫。据说旅人在穿越沙漠前，会将多余行李留在他的墓旁，相信圣墓的神圣地位足以保障物品安全。后来一位到访者还见到聚落附近有座带圆形角堡的泥筑要塞。河流、商队与神圣庇护，共同解释了这处看似荒凉之地的重要性。

english: Abu Jungle belongs to the wider Melpa-speaking world of Papua New Guinea. Around Mount Hagen and the neighbouring highlands, Melpa communities preserve a special pandanus vocabulary used during karuka harvests and a distinctive binary counting system.
simp_chinese: 阿布丛林属于巴布亚新几内亚更广阔的梅尔帕语世界。在哈根山及邻近高地，梅尔帕社群保留着采收卡鲁卡露兜树果时使用的专门词汇，以及独特的二进制计数系统。

english: Abu Kamal stands on the Euphrates where the river country of Syria continues toward Iraq. The name al-Bukamal refers to the family or tribe of Kamal, while the Ottoman name Qashla recalled military barracks. In the seventeenth century it served as the seat of a sanjak within the province of Raqqa. The river also imposed its own demands: in 1896 the old mud-built village was moved upstream to escape flood danger. Tribal settlement, imperial administration and the changing Euphrates all left their mark on the place.
simp_chinese: 阿布凯马勒坐落于幼发拉底河畔，叙利亚的河川地区由此延向伊拉克。布卡马勒之名指卡马勒家族或部族，奥斯曼时期的卡什拉一名则让人想到军营。十七世纪，这里曾是拉卡行省内一处桑贾克的治所。河流也有自己的要求：1896年，为躲避洪水危险，原有土坯村落迁往上游。部族聚居、帝国行政与变化的幼发拉底河，共同留下了印记。

english: Abu Qasr belongs to the wider Arabian country of West Asia. The peninsula lies between the Red Sea and Persian Gulf, with Mesopotamia and the Levant along its northern approaches.
simp_chinese: 阿布卡斯尔属于西亚更广阔的阿拉伯地区。半岛位于红海与波斯湾之间，北部通向美索不达米亚与黎凡特。

english: Abu Rakah belongs to the wider Turbah country southeast of Mecca. The regional valley lies south of Jebel Hadhn, near the meeting of the Hejaz and Najd landscapes; its principal town is traditionally associated with the Al-Bugum tribe.
simp_chinese: 阿布拉卡属于麦加东南方广义的图尔巴地区。当地河谷位于哈丹山以南，接近汉志与内志地貌的交界；主要城镇传统上与布古姆部族相联系。

english: The waters around Abulat belong to the Red Sea between Africa and Arabia. Extensive shallow shelves support rich coral communities. Farther south, Bab-el-Mandeb connects this long enclosed basin with the Gulf of Aden and the Indian Ocean.
simp_chinese: 阿布拉特周边水域属于非洲与阿拉伯之间的红海。广阔浅海陆架支撑丰富珊瑚群落。更南方曼德海峡将绵长封闭海盆与亚丁湾、印度洋连接。

english: Abun belongs to the Bird’s Head Peninsula of northwestern New Guinea. The wider peninsula faces Cenderawasih Bay to the east and Bintuni Bay to the south, with the Dampier Strait along its western side.
simp_chinese: 阿本属于新几内亚西北部的鸟头半岛。更广阔的半岛东临极乐鸟湾、南接宾图尼湾，西侧沿岸为丹皮尔海峡。

english: The Abun Coast belongs to the New Guinea end of Melanesia in the southwestern Pacific. The wider island region stretches eastward from New Guinea to Fiji and includes both Papuan and Austronesian cultural worlds.
simp_chinese: 阿本海岸位于西南太平洋美拉尼西亚靠近新几内亚的一端。这片广大岛屿区域由新几内亚向东延伸至斐济，包括巴布亚与南岛文化世界。

english: Aburakeiru belongs to the Leeward Islands, where the northeastern Caribbean meets the Atlantic. The wider island arc was formed largely by volcanism, with high rugged ground and reefs linking islands from the Virgin Islands toward Guadeloupe.
simp_chinese: 阿布拉凯鲁属于加勒比东北与大西洋相遇处的背风群岛。更广阔的岛弧大部由火山活动形成，崎岖高地与珊瑚礁贯穿从维尔京群岛延向瓜德罗普的岛屿。

english: The Aburrá Valley follows the Medellín River through Colombia’s Central Cordillera. Its south-to-north alignment descends between mountain walls, and its name preserves that of the indigenous Aburraes who lived here before Spanish settlement.
simp_chinese: 阿布拉谷地沿麦德林河穿过哥伦比亚中央山脉。谷地在两侧山地之间由南向北降低，其名称保留了西班牙人定居之前当地原住民阿布拉人的族名。

english: Abuta belongs to the wider Iburi country of Hokkaido. The later subprefecture began as Muroran in 1897 and adopted the name Iburi in 1922.
simp_chinese: 虻田属于北海道更广阔的胆振地区。后来的支厅于一八九七年以室兰之名设立，一九二二年改称胆振。

english: Abutua belongs to the middle Zambezi country. The great river links inland southern Africa with Mozambique and the Indian Ocean. Victoria Falls is its most famous cascade, while the later Kariba reservoir transformed a large stretch between Zambia and Zimbabwe.
simp_chinese: 阿布图阿属于赞比西河中游地区。这条大河将南部非洲内陆与莫桑比克及印度洋相连。维多利亚瀑布是最著名的瀑布，而后来的卡里巴水库改变了赞比亚与津巴布韦之间一大段河流。

english:
Aby Lagoon forms a broad, shallow water landscape across the border of southeastern Ivory Coast and southwestern Ghana. It is a choked coastal lagoon, meaning that sandbars and a narrow Atlantic outlet restrict the exchange of water with the sea. The complex consists of three connected sections: Aby Lagoon proper in the west, Tendo Lagoon in the center, and Ehy Lagoon in the east. Together they cover about 424 square kilometers, with an average depth of only 3.5 meters.

The largest section, the main Aby Lagoon, covers 305 square kilometers. It stretches about 24.5 kilometers north from the mouth of the complex and reaches a maximum width of 15.5 kilometers. Its shallow basin is turbulent when winds stir the water, and its salinity changes according to rainfall, river discharge, and the state of the narrow sea opening. The Bia River feeds the western section from the north. The Tano River, after a course of roughly four hundred kilometers through Ghana, enters Tendo Lagoon from the east. Together the two rivers drain a basin of about 27,650 square kilometers.

The lagoon system gives the border region a shared environment of channels, floodplains, swamp forest, and coastal sand barriers. Fishing and agriculture are the principal activities around its shores. Local communities occupy small settlements linked by boats and paths, moving between fields, fishing grounds, and markets rather than treating the international boundary as a permanent barrier. The lower Tano and neighboring wetlands are also notable for protected habitats and for the last known populations of Miss Waldron’s red colobus, one of the world’s most threatened primates.

In Bono tradition, the source of the Tano River is associated with Ta Kora, a powerful deity of war and lightning personified by the river. That sacred geography extends the importance of the waterway beyond transport and food: the river connects a distant inland origin with the coastal lagoons and the Atlantic. Aby therefore belongs to a much larger system in which rainfall, rivers, forests, fisheries, and seasonal floods determine both ecology and human opportunity. Its future depends on how the two countries manage a shared watershed through mining, farmland expansion, and the growing pressure on wetlands.
simp_chinese:
阿比潟湖横跨科特迪瓦东南部与加纳西南部的边界，是一片宽阔而浅平的沿海水域。它属于受沙洲和狭窄海口限制的潟湖系统，与海洋之间水体交换较慢。整个复合潟湖由三部分组成：西部是阿比潟湖主体，中部为滕多潟湖，东部为埃希潟湖，总面积约424平方公里，平均深度只有3.5米。

面积最大的主体部分约305平方公里，从复合潟湖海口向西北延伸约24.5公里，最宽处15.5公里。浅水盆地在大风吹动时容易翻涌，盐度则随降雨、河流流量和海口开闭而变化。比亚河从北部注入西部主体，而流经加纳约400公里后抵达海岸的塔诺河，从东部进入滕多潟湖。两条河及周围水系形成的集水面积约2.765万平方公里。

这套潟湖赋予边境地区一套共享环境，包括水道、泛滥平原、沼泽森林和海岸沙障。沿岸居民主要从事捕鱼和农业，聚落之间依靠船只和小路联系；人们往返于田地、渔场和集市，国界并不是生活的唯一界线。下游塔诺河及邻近湿地还拥有受保护的森林生境，并被认为是极度濒危的沃尔德伦红疣猴最后可能存活的地区之一。

在加纳博诺地区的传统信仰中，塔诺河源头与战争和闪电之神 Ta Kora 相联系，河流本身就是这位神祇的化身。这种神圣地理使水道不只具有运输和食物意义：它把内地的神性源头同沿海潟湖和大西洋连接起来。阿比潟湖因此嵌在更大的环境系统之中，季节降雨、河川、森林、渔业与洪水共同决定生态和人的生计。采矿、农业扩张及湿地压力之下，这项跨境资源如何由加纳和科特迪瓦共同管理，将直接影响当地居民和珍稀物种的未来。潟湖本身并不封闭，雨季河流带来的淡水和海口进入的海水不断改变盐度与水色。正是这种半开放环境形成肥沃湿地，也让沿岸聚落面对水涨水落时必须调整渔业、农业和交通方式。塔诺—比亚水系连接内地森林、国家边界和海口，渔获与农田收成都随水量变化。因此，这片潟湖的研究需要同时观察降雨、河川、海口沙障与人类土地利用，而不能只把它看成地图上静止的一块水面。

english: The Gulf of Aden separates Yemen from the Horn of Africa. Its western end leads through Bab-el-Mandeb into the Red Sea, while the east opens toward the Arabian Sea.
simp_chinese: 亚丁湾分隔也门与非洲之角。西端经曼德海峡通向红海，东侧则面向阿拉伯海。

english: Abyy is a village in the Sakha country of eastern Siberia. It lies about eighty kilometres from Belaya Gora and had fewer than five hundred residents in 2010.
simp_chinese: 阿贝是西伯利亚东部萨哈地区的一座村庄。它距别拉亚戈拉约80公里，2010年居民不足500人。

english:
Acambaro stands on the Lerma River in the country between the central Mexican plateau and Michoacan. Its name is linked to the maguey plant, while archaeological remains connect the surrounding region with the ancient Chupicuaro culture. Before Spanish intervention the settlement belonged to the Purepecha world, making it part of a political landscape with its own long history.

Spanish forces and their Otomi allies entered the place in 1526, and San Francisco de Acambaro became an early colonial foundation in what is now Guanajuato. Franciscan activity left religious buildings, while an aqueduct and a later stone bridge over the Lerma recorded the growing demands of the town. In October 1810 Miguel Hidalgo gathered insurgent forces here and received the title Generalissimo of the Americas. The town's later railway importance continued an older pattern of movement through the river corridor. Its famous bread belongs to another form of exchange, carrying the name of Acambaro far beyond the valley where the settlement began.
simp_chinese:
阿坎巴罗坐落在莱尔马河畔，处于墨西哥中部高原与米却肯之间。城名与龙舌兰有关，周围考古遗物又把此地联系到古老的丘皮夸罗文化。西班牙人到来以前，聚落属于普雷佩查世界，因此这里早已有自己的政治与文化历史。

1526年，西班牙军队及其奥托米盟友进入此地，圣弗朗西斯科德阿坎巴罗成为今瓜纳华托一带的早期殖民聚落。方济各会修建宗教建筑，引水渠及后来横跨莱尔马河的石桥则记录着城镇的发展。1810年10月，伊达尔戈在此集合起义军并接受“美洲大元帅”称号。较晚的铁路枢纽地位延续了沿河通行的旧格局，而闻名远近的阿坎巴罗面包又通过另一种交流，把城名带出了所在河谷。

english: Acanti is the Indigenous name behind modern Acandí, interpreted as River of Stone. The locality lies in the Darién country of northwestern Colombia, beside Panama and the Caribbean Sea.
simp_chinese: 阿坎蒂是现代阿坎迪地名的原住民语来源，意为石头之河。这一地方位于哥伦比亚西北部达连地区，邻接巴拿马与加勒比海。

english:
Acaponeta lies along its namesake river in the northern coastal country of Nayarit. The settlement's indigenous name preserves an association with water and vegetation: traditional explanations speak of a place beside a river, or of beans tangled among reeds. The words offer a small glimpse of how the landscape was identified before later administrative boundaries were drawn.

The river and the seasonal rains sustain an agricultural district producing maize, beans, and other crops, with livestock adding another livelihood. Heat and a strongly concentrated rainy season shape the use of the land. Later a railway station connected the town with the long route between northern Mexico and the capital, giving a local river settlement a place in a much wider transport network. Acaponeta's interest lies in this continuity of landscape and exchange: an indigenous river name, cultivated lowlands, and a town serving the movement of agricultural goods. Modern processing of maize and fruit extends those productive ties without erasing their dependence on the surrounding countryside.
simp_chinese:
阿卡波内塔位于纳亚里特北部沿海地域，同名河流穿过城镇。其原住民地名保存着水与植被之间的联系：一种解释是“河边的地方”，另一种则描绘豆蔓缠绕芦苇的景象。这些称呼让人得以窥见后来行政边界出现之前，当地人如何辨认自己的土地。

河流与季节性降雨滋养着种植玉米、豆类及其他作物的农业地区，畜牧又提供另一种生计。炎热天气和高度集中的雨季影响土地利用。较晚修建的铁路站把城镇接入墨西哥北部通往首都的长途网络，使一个地方性河畔聚落进入更广阔的交通体系。原住民河名、低地农田与农产品运输共同构成阿卡波内塔的特色；后来的玉米和水果加工，也仍依靠城外乡村所提供的产物。

english: Acapulco's bay opened New Spain to the Pacific routes reaching across the ocean. Galleons arrived on an annual circuit from the sixteenth into the early nineteenth century, bringing valuable cargoes that also attracted raiders. The fort of San Diego was built in 1616 to guard the harbour, then rebuilt after the earthquake of 1776. In 1614 the bay received Hasekura Tsunenaga's Japanese embassy on its journey toward Catholic Europe; some members remained and married locally. Merchants, soldiers and envoys made this sheltered water a meeting place between continents.
simp_chinese: 阿卡普尔科湾使新西班牙得以接入横越太平洋的航线。自十六世纪至十九世纪初，大帆船每年沿固定航路到来，带来的珍贵货物也吸引了海上劫掠者。圣迭戈堡于1616年建造以保卫港口，后又在1776年地震后重建。1614年，支仓常长率领的日本使团在前往天主教欧洲途中抵达此湾，其中一些成员留居并与当地人通婚。商人、士兵与使节，使这片避风水域成为连接大陆的相会之地。

english:
Acarau occupies the river country near the northern Atlantic coast of Ceara. The river gives the settlement its setting and its name, while fishing, cultivation, and cattle raising connect the shoreline with the inland country. Its later fame as a producer of lobster is a reminder that the waters beyond the river mouth can matter as much as the fields along its banks.

The name preserves an indigenous view of this landscape, although its precise interpretation is disputed. One explanation joins words for a heron and water; another understands the first element as a type of fish and reads the whole as a river associated with that fish. Both interpretations link the place to living things in and beside the water. The modern municipality dates from the nineteenth century, but its identity is more deeply rooted in the river landscape than in that administrative foundation. Here the history of a small coastal place is carried by its name, its subsistence, and the movement between fresh water and the sea.
simp_chinese:
阿卡劳位于塞阿拉北部临近大西洋的河川地域，同名河流既塑造了聚落的位置，也留下了它的名称。捕鱼、耕作和养牛把海岸同内陆联系起来，后来闻名的龙虾生产又说明，河口之外的海水与两岸农地同样关系居民生计。

地名保留着原住民辨认环境的方式，但具体解释仍有争议。一说把它理解为鹭与水的组合，另一说认为前半部分指一种鱼，因而全名是与这种鱼有关的河流。两种解释都把这个地方同水中或水边的生物联系在一起。现代自治市成立于十九世纪，但地方认同并不只来自行政设立的日期，也来自河流、捕鱼和淡水与海洋之间持续不断的往来。

english: Acari belongs to Peru’s wider Chala coastal region. This low desert country supports riverine vegetation and scattered hill ecosystems sustained by coastal fog and mist.
simp_chinese: 阿卡里属于秘鲁更广阔的查拉沿海地区。这片低地荒漠支持河岸植被，并在沿海雾气滋养下形成零散的山丘生态系统。

english: Acasaguastlán lies in the El Progreso region of Guatemala. The municipality includes San Agustín Acasaguastlán and smaller settlements such as Tulumaje.
simp_chinese: 阿卡萨瓜斯特兰位于危地马拉埃尔普罗格雷索地区。该市镇包括圣阿古斯丁阿卡萨瓜斯特兰及图卢马赫等较小聚落。

english:
Acatic stands at the approach to Los Altos, the highland country of Jalisco. Its position has earned it the description of a gateway: the town marks a passage from neighboring lowlands and routes into a region with its own pattern of settlements and production. Its municipal history includes named local officeholders reaching back into the eighteenth century, a modest but useful trace of the institutions through which the town was governed.

The surrounding economy joins agriculture with the working of earth and stone. Maize and chia belong to the fields, while bricks, adobe floor tiles, and Spanish-style roof tiles belong to workshops and building sites. Tequila production adds a further connection with the wider identity of Jalisco. Such activities make Acatic more than a point on the road. The materials used in houses and courtyards, as well as the crops carried to market, tie the settlement to the everyday construction and provisioning of the highlands.
simp_chinese:
阿卡蒂克位于哈利斯科高地洛斯阿尔托斯的入口，因而常被视作通往这一地区的门户。道路从邻近地域进入高地，在这里接续到具有自身聚落与生产格局的地方。现存地方行政记载中的任职者姓名可追溯至十八世纪，为了解城镇如何治理留下了朴素而具体的线索。

农田与手工作坊共同维持当地生计。玉米和奇亚籽出自田地，砖、土坯地砖与西班牙式屋瓦则进入房屋和庭院；龙舌兰酒生产又使这里与更广阔的哈利斯科地域相联系。阿卡蒂克因此不只是道路上的一个名字，居民使用的建筑材料和运往市场的农产，也把城镇嵌入高地日常营建与供给的网络之中。

english: Nevado de Acay rises above the Calchaquí valley in Argentina’s Salta region. It is an exposed Miocene volcanic intrusion and supplies several streams, including the Río Salado.
simp_chinese: 阿卡伊山耸立在阿根廷萨尔塔地区的卡尔查基谷地之上。它由中新世火山侵入体出露形成，是包括萨拉多河在内的多条河流的源头。

english:
Acayucan lies in southeastern Veracruz, within the region associated with the Olmeca name. The settlement serves the surrounding municipality and belongs to the lowland world connecting the southern Gulf coast with the interior of the Mexican isthmus. Its history should be distinguished from the history of the entire ancient Olmec civilization: the regional label alone does not establish the age or political role of the town itself.

The surviving administrative chronology records recognition as a town in 1848 and as a city in 1910. These later changes show the gradual formal growth of a local center rather than the foundation of every settlement in the surrounding countryside. The town's church of Saint Martin forms one of its visible landmarks. Acayucan offers a quieter perspective on the Gulf lowlands, where local communities, religious buildings, and administrative functions accumulated beneath names that recall a much older regional landscape.
simp_chinese:
阿卡尤坎位于韦拉克鲁斯东南部，属于以奥尔梅卡之名标识的地域，也是周围自治市的中心。它处在墨西哥湾南部低地与地峡内陆相联系的环境之中。这里需要区分城镇自身与整个古代奥尔梅克文明的历史：区域名称并不能单独证明这座聚落的年代或政治地位。

行政沿革记载其在1848年获得镇地位，1910年取得城市地位。这些较晚的变化反映一个地方中心的逐渐成长，并不意味着周围乡村此前不存在。圣马丁教堂是城中的醒目标志之一。阿卡尤坎呈现了海湾低地较为日常的一面：聚落、宗教建筑和行政职能层层累积，而地方名称又使人联想到更古老的区域景观。

english: Accomac lies on Virginia’s Eastern Shore. The surrounding county dates to the seventeenth-century colonial shires, and the area became associated with religious communities including the early Presbyterian minister Francis Makemie.
simp_chinese: 阿科马克位于弗吉尼亚东岸。周边县域源自十七世纪殖民时期的郡制，当地也与早期长老会牧师弗朗西斯·麦凯米等宗教社群有关。

english:
Accra lies on the Atlantic coast of West Africa in the territory of the Ga people. The name comes from the Akan word Nkran, meaning “ants,” a reference to the conspicuous anthills of the surrounding countryside. In Ga the place and people are called Ga or Gaga, a related name. Sacred fences sometimes surrounded the tall anthills, which communities regarded as links between the living world and the dead. The European spelling Accra and the modern capital grew from a landscape in which settlement, trade, ancestor veneration, and fortification were closely intertwined.

By the fifteenth century the kingdom of Accra ruled from Ayawaso. Its coast was not initially the region’s leading commercial center; Ada, Prampram, Dodowa, and Akuse occupied stronger positions in the export and inland trades. A Portuguese fort was destroyed by local inhabitants in 1576, after which business shifted onto the beaches. During the seventeenth century the Dutch built Fort Crèvecoeur, the British built Fort James, and the Swedes established Christiansborg, later held by Denmark. These forts made the coast a contested interface between African polities and competing European traders.

Accra was a regional power by 1646, although it depended on the rising Akwamu kingdom’s control of routes into the interior. Civil conflict and the invasion of 1677 shattered Ayawaso: Akwamu’s ruler killed King Okai Koi and drove his son Ofori toward the small settlement beneath Fort Crèvecoeur. Danish cannon helped the survivors resist, but renewed war in 1681 burned Osu and Small Accra and forced Ofori into exile. The separate towns around Fort James, Fort Crèvecoeur and Christiansborg remained visible in the later districts of Jamestown, Usshertown, and Osu.

Britain gradually absorbed the other European forts, purchasing the Danish establishments in 1851 and the Dutch ones in 1871. After the British captured Kumasi and Accra during the Anglo-Asante wars, Accra replaced Cape Coast as the capital of the Gold Coast in 1877; its drier climate was one reason for the change. The new administrative role brought colonial officials and rapid urban expansion beyond the old line between Ussher Fort and the Korle Lagoon. Accra therefore grew out of several Ga settlements and foreign trading forts, becoming a commercial and political center whose streets carry the memory of local kingdoms, Atlantic commerce, and colonial rule.
simp_chinese:
阿克拉位于西非几内亚湾沿岸，地处加族人的传统地域。城市名称来自阿坎语 Nkran，意为“蚂蚁”，指当地乡间醒目的蚁丘。在加语中，这一地区及其居民被称为 Ga 或 Gaga，与 Nkran 同源。高大的蚁丘有时被围以神圣栅栏，在社区观念中成为人间与亡者世界之间的联系。欧洲人后来拼写的 Accra 和今日的加纳首都，都源于这样一个聚落、贸易、祖先崇拜与堡垒相互交织的环境。

到十五世纪，阿克拉王国以阿亚瓦索为都城统治当地。最初的沿海贸易中心并非阿克拉，而是阿达、普拉姆普拉姆等港口，以及多杜瓦、阿库塞等内陆市场。1576年，当地人摧毁了一座葡萄牙堡垒，此后交易更多直接在海滩上进行。十七世纪，荷兰人修建克雷弗克堡，英国人修建詹姆斯堡，瑞典人建立克里斯蒂安堡，后者后来又由丹麦控制。这些堡垒使海岸成为非洲各王国与竞争中的欧洲商团交汇和争夺的前沿。

到1646年，阿克拉已经成为地区强权，但它仍依赖崛起的阿夸穆王国控制通往内陆的商路。内战和1677年的入侵摧毁了阿亚瓦索：阿夸穆军杀死国王奥凯·科伊，其子奥福里退到克雷弗克堡城墙附近的小阿克拉。丹麦人的火炮一度帮助幸存者抵挡进攻，但1681年新的战争烧毁奥苏和小阿克拉，奥福里被迫流亡。詹姆斯堡、克雷弗克堡和克里斯蒂安堡周边的不同聚落，后来分别发展为詹姆斯敦、厄舍敦和奥苏等城区。

英国逐步接收其他欧洲国家的堡垒，1851年购入丹麦据点，1871年又接手荷兰据点。在英阿散蒂战争期间，英军先后攻占库马西和阿克拉。1877年，阿克拉因气候较海岸角干燥等原因取代后者，成为英属黄金海岸首府。行政中心的迁入引来殖民官员，也让城市越过厄舍堡与科尔勒潟湖之间的旧边界迅速扩张。阿克拉由数个加族聚落和欧洲贸易堡垒共同成长而来，街道与城区至今仍保存着地方王国、大西洋贸易和殖民统治层层叠加的历史。从围绕堡垒分布的加族聚落，到大英黄金海岸首府，再到独立后的加纳首都，阿克拉的城市形态始终由海岸贸易、内陆政治和不断迁入的人口共同塑造。

english: The Accra shore faces the Gulf of Guinea on Ghana's southern coast. Later settlements around British, Dutch and Danish forts merged into the city, preserving several distinct coastal quarters.
simp_chinese: 阿克拉海岸位于加纳南部，面向几内亚湾。后来英国、荷兰和丹麦堡垒周围的聚落合并为城市，保留了多个不同的沿海街区。

english:
Acerenza rises on a commanding hill in Basilicata, high above the surrounding southern Italian countryside. Known in antiquity as Acherontia, it was taken by Rome in 318 BCE and later became a fortress contested by Ostrogoths and Lombards. The strength of its position brought repeated struggles for its possession; Charlemagne ordered its walls destroyed in 788, and Norman conquest followed in 1041 after conflict between Salerno and Byzantine interests.

The town's religious standing proved as durable as its military value. A bishop is recorded by the end of the fifth century, and Acerenza became an archiepiscopal seat in 1068. Its cathedral, begun in 1080, gathered later works of art and a sixteenth-century crypt into a building whose long construction history mirrors the layers of the town itself. In the early modern period local lordship became a duchy granted under the Spanish monarchy. Fortress, episcopal center, and noble possession thus met on the same small hill.
simp_chinese:
阿切伦扎高踞巴西利卡塔的山丘，俯瞰意大利南部乡野。古名阿刻龙提亚的聚落于公元前318年被罗马征服，后来又成为东哥特人与伦巴第人争夺的要塞。险要地形使城墙和城镇不断卷入战争：查理曼于788年下令毁墙，1041年诺曼人又在萨莱诺与拜占庭势力的争夺之后夺取此地。

宗教地位同军事价值一样持久。五世纪末已有主教记载，1068年这里升为总主教座。1080年动工的主教座堂逐渐汇集后世艺术品和十六世纪地下圣堂，建筑自身也像城镇一样由多个时代叠成。近世领主权又在西班牙王室之下升为公爵领，使这座山丘同时承载着要塞、教会中心与贵族领地的历史。

english:
Achacachi stands on the high Altiplano beside the eastern shores of Lake Titicaca. At nearly four thousand metres above sea level, it belongs to a landscape in which the lake, the plateau, and the mountains define the limits of movement and settlement. Its regional setting is reflected in Umasuyus, an Aymara name associated with the shore.

The settlement existed before Spanish arrival. Colonial chronicles and official accounts remembered it as the center of the Pacasa lordship, part of the political world of the Colla peoples. This older standing distinguishes Achacachi from a town created only by later colonial administration. The place connects the history of Andean lordships with a lake environment shared by many communities. Its modern role as the center of Omasuyos continues the association between a settlement and its surrounding district, but the deeper interest lies in the survival of a pre-Hispanic regional identity beside one of the Andes' great bodies of water.
simp_chinese:
阿查卡奇坐落在的的喀喀湖东岸的阿尔蒂普拉诺高原，海拔接近四千米。湖泊、高原与山脉共同限定了这里的通行和聚落分布；乌马苏尤这一与湖岸有关的艾马拉名称，也体现了地方对环境的认识。

聚落在西班牙人到来以前已经存在。殖民时代的编年记与官方记述，把它描绘为帕卡萨领地的中心，属于科利亚诸社群的政治世界。因此，阿查卡奇的地位并非完全由后来的殖民行政创造。这里把安第斯地方领主的历史同多个社群共享的湖区联系起来。现代奥马苏约斯中心的职能延续了城镇与周围地域之间的关系，而更深的特色则是前西班牙时代地域认同在安第斯大湖旁的延续。

english: Achachiwa belongs to the southern Peruvian highlands, with the wider Espinar area forming part of the Cusco region. Its regional settlements include Yauri, Coporaque and Pichigua; in modern times, the Tintaya copper mine has become a focus of disputes over development and environmental standards.
simp_chinese: 阿查奇瓦位于秘鲁南部高地，以库斯科地区的埃斯皮纳尔一带为区域背景。当地聚落包括尧里、科波拉克与皮奇瓜；近现代的廷塔亚铜矿成为地区发展与环境标准争议的焦点。

english: Achaivayam belongs to the Koryak country north of Kamchatka. Across the wider region, Koryak communities occupied Bering Sea coasts and inland country toward the Anadyr basin, with languages related to Alyutor and Chukchi and traditions distinguishing coastal village dwellers from inland groups.
simp_chinese: 阿恰伊瓦亚姆位于堪察加以北的科里亚克地区。在整个大区，科里亚克社群生活于白令海沿岸及向阿纳德尔流域延伸的内陆，语言与阿柳托尔语和楚科奇语相近，传统上区分沿海村居者与内陆群体。

english: Achaka belongs to the northern Kolyma country. The wider region reaches toward the East Siberian Sea and contains extensive permafrost and tundra under a severe subarctic climate.
simp_chinese: 阿恰卡属于科雷马北部地区。更广区域延伸向东西伯利亚海，严酷亚寒带气候下分布着广大永久冻土和冻原。

english: Acham forms part of the Nepalese Himalayan region. Nepal spans fertile plains, forested hills and some of the highest mountains on earth, joining landscapes influenced by both India and Tibet.
simp_chinese: 阿恰姆位于尼泊尔喜马拉雅地区。尼泊尔横跨肥沃平原、森林丘陵及世界最高的部分山峰，连接受到印度与西藏影响的不同地域。

english: Achan lies in the lower Amur basin, included in the broad historical definition of Manchuria. The wider region was home to diverse peoples, including Nanai, Nivkh, Ulch, Mongol and Manchu communities.
simp_chinese: 阿枪位于黑龙江下游流域，属于广义历史满洲的范围。整个大区域曾生活着那乃、尼夫赫、乌尔奇、蒙古和满洲等众多族群。

english: Achava belongs to Kamchatka’s eastern country facing the Pacific. Across the peninsula, volcanoes form part of the Pacific Ring of Fire, while the Sea of Okhotsk lies beyond the western coast.
simp_chinese: 阿恰瓦属于堪察加面向太平洋的东部地区。整个半岛的火山是环太平洋火山带的一部分，西岸之外则是鄂霍次克海。

english: This coast opens toward the Chukchi Sea at the edge of the Arctic Ocean. Bering Strait forms that sea’s southern outlet and connects it with the Bering Sea and Pacific.
simp_chinese: 这段海岸面向北冰洋边缘的楚科奇海。白令海峡位于该海的南端，将它与白令海及太平洋连接起来。

english: Achen belongs to the Chubut part of Patagonia. The wider Patagonian landscape ranges from Andean lakes, forests and glaciers in the west to tablelands and steppe in the east.
simp_chinese: 阿琴属于巴塔哥尼亚的丘布特地区。更广阔的巴塔哥尼亚景观从西部安第斯山脉的湖泊、森林与冰川，过渡到东部的台地与草原。

english: Achikamii belongs to the ancient rock country of the Abitibi uplands. The wider Abitibi greenstone belt crosses Ontario and Quebec and formed around 2.8 to 2.6 billion years ago. Volcanic rocks dominate this immense Archean belt, interspersed with ancient sediments and granitoids.
simp_chinese: 阿奇卡米属于阿比蒂比高地的古老岩石地域。广大阿比蒂比绿岩带横跨安大略与魁北克，形成于约二十八亿至二十六亿年前。火山岩主导这片辽阔太古宙岩带，其间分布古老沉积岩与花岗质岩石。

english:
Achim occupies the right bank of the Weser southeast of Bremen, where higher ground borders a broad river depression and former moorland. First recorded as Arahem in 1091, the place was associated with an old Saxon court that assembled several times a year. Its early standing was therefore legal and communal as well as geographical.

A baptismal church established by Christian missionaries was followed by Saint Lawrence's church in the thirteenth century, when the settlement belonged to the prince-archbishopric of Bremen. In 1381 conflict during the Luneburg succession war brought fire to Achim, showing how a local community could suffer from the rivalries of neighboring rulers. Danish and Swedish interventions followed in the seventeenth century. The transformation of the ecclesiastical principality into the Duchy of Bremen in 1648 brought Swedish rule, before Hanoverian authority took hold in the next century. Beneath these changes of sovereignty remained a riverside settlement whose courts, parish, and routes linked it to the wider Weser country.
simp_chinese:
阿希姆位于不来梅东南、威悉河右岸，较高地面在此与宽阔河谷及昔日沼泽相接。1091年文献中的阿拉海姆与古老的萨克森法庭相联系，法庭每年数次集会，说明这个地方早期的重要性既来自地形，也来自共同体的法律活动。

传教士建立的洗礼教堂之后，十三世纪又出现圣劳伦斯教堂，当时聚落属于不来梅总主教领。1381年，吕讷堡继承战争中的冲突焚毁阿希姆，邻近统治者的争夺由此直接落在地方居民身上。十七世纪丹麦与瑞典势力相继介入，1648年教会领地改为不来梅公国后归瑞典统治，下一世纪又转向汉诺威。在这些主权变化之下，法庭、教区与沿河道路始终把城镇同更广阔的威悉河地域联系起来。

english: Achit Lake lies in western Mongolia at an elevation of about 1,435 metres. Steppe and low hills surround its freshwater basin, while marshy ground fringes its northern shores.
simp_chinese: 阿奇特湖位于蒙古西部，海拔约一千四百三十五米。草原与低山环绕淡水湖盆，北部岸边则分布沼泽地。

english: Acholi belongs to the Albert Nile country of the East African interior. The wider White Nile system links Lake Victoria through Kyoga and Albert with rivers flowing north into South Sudan and eventually toward the main Nile.
simp_chinese: 阿乔利属于东非内陆的艾伯特尼罗河地区。更广阔的白尼罗河水系将维多利亚湖经基奥加湖、艾伯特湖与向北流入南苏丹并最终通向尼罗河干流的河道联系起来。

english:
Achomawi names the river people and communities of the Pit River country in northeastern California. Their territories extended through contrasting environments, from forested mountain valleys to drier country of sagebrush and juniper. The name applies most precisely to one river community but has also been used for a wider group of related bands.

Each band maintained its own territory and several villages, with a central settlement and smaller neighboring communities. Housing responded to the seasons: light summer shelters and mats gave way to larger winter dwellings set partly below ground, with wooden frames covered by bark, grass, and tule. Food gathering and seasonal movements differed along the river because the landscape itself changed. These were not simply scattered settlements awaiting an outside state, but communities with their own territorial knowledge and institutions. Later forced removal to the Pit River Reservation disrupted that world, while the river names and related languages continued to preserve connections among its people.
simp_chinese:
